manualTranslations.zh: 帝思念舅氏不已。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor thought of his maternal kin without cease.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor could not stop thinking of his maternal kin.

manualTranslations.zh: 暢尚幼，景初末，以暢為射聲校尉，加散騎常侍，又特為起大第，車駕親自臨之。
manualTranslations.literal: Chang was still young; at the end of Jingchu he was made Colonel of the Archers Who Shoot at Sound and additionally Regular Attendant; a great mansion was specially built for him, and the imperial carriage personally visited it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chang was still young. At the end of Jingchu he was made Colonel of the Archers Who Shoot at Sound and Regular Attendant. A great mansion was specially built for him, and the emperor personally visited it.

manualTranslations.zh: 又於其后園為像母起觀廟，名其里曰渭陽里，以追思母氏也。
manualTranslations.literal: Also in the empress's rear garden a viewing temple was built for Xiang's mother; the lane was named Weiyang Lane, to recall and think of the maternal clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the empress's rear garden a viewing temple was also built for Xiang's mother. The lane was named Weiyang Lane in remembrance of the maternal clan.

manualTranslations.zh: 嘉平三年251年正月，暢薨，追贈車騎將軍，諡曰恭侯；
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the third year of Jiaping (251 CE), Chang died; posthumously he was granted General of Chariots and Cavalry and given the posthumous title Marquis Gong;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of Jiaping 3 (251 CE), Chang died. He was posthumously made General of Chariots and Cavalry and given the posthumous title Marquis Gong;

manualTranslations.zh: 子紹嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: his son Shao succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: his son Shao succeeded.

manualTranslations.zh: 太和六年，明帝愛女淑薨，追封諡淑為平原懿公主，為之立廟。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year of Taihe, Ming-di's beloved daughter Shu died; posthumously she was enfeoffed and titled Princess Yi of Pingyuan, and a temple was built for her.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taihe 6, Ming-di's beloved daughter Shu died. She was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess Yi of Pingyuan, and a temple was built for her.

manualTranslations.zh: 取后亡從孫黃與合葬，追封黃列侯，以夫人郭氏從弟德為之後，承甄氏姓，封德為平原侯，襲公主爵。
manualTranslations.literal: The empress's deceased grandnephew Huang was taken to be buried with her; Huang was posthumously enfeoffed as a full marquis; Lady Guo's younger cousin De was made his heir, took the Zhen surname, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Pingyuan, and inherited the princess's title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress's deceased grandnephew Huang was buried with her and posthumously enfeoffed as a full marquis. Lady Guo's younger cousin De was made his heir, took the Zhen surname, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Pingyuan, and inherited the princess's title.

manualTranslations.zh: 孫盛曰：於禮，婦人既無封爵之典，況於孩末，而可建以大邑乎？
manualTranslations.literal: Sun Sheng said: By ritual, women already have no norm of enfeoffment and titles—how much less a child in infancy; could one establish a great fief for such a case?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Sheng said: "By ritual, women have no norm of enfeoffment and titles. How much less an infant child—could one establish a great fief in such a case?"

manualTranslations.zh: 德自異族，援繼非類，匪功匪親，而襲母爵，違情背典，於此為甚。
manualTranslations.literal: De came from a different clan; to pull in and continue an unsuitable line, neither by merit nor by kinship, yet to inherit a mother's title—this violates feeling and turns against the canon; in this matter the offense is extreme.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: De came from a different clan. To install him as heir without merit or kinship, yet have him inherit a mother's title, violates both feeling and canon—and here the offense was extreme.

manualTranslations.zh: 陳群雖抗言，楊阜引事比並，然皆不能極陳先王之禮，明封建繼嗣之義，忠至之辭，猶有闕乎！
manualTranslations.literal: Although Chen Qun spoke out boldly and Yang Fu cited parallel cases, neither could fully set forth the rites of the former kings or clarify the meaning of enfeoffment and succession; their words of utmost loyalty still had gaps!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although Chen Qun spoke out boldly and Yang Fu cited parallel cases, neither fully set forth the rites of the former kings or clarified the meaning of enfeoffment and succession. Even their most loyal remonstrance left something unsaid!

manualTranslations.zh: 詩云：「赫赫師尹，民具爾瞻。」
manualTranslations.literal: The Odes say: "Splendid is the master minister; the people all look to you."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Odes say, "Splendid is the master minister; the people all look to you."

manualTranslations.zh: 宰輔之職，其可略哉！
manualTranslations.literal: The duty of chief ministers—can it be treated lightly!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The duty of chief ministers—can it be treated lightly!

manualTranslations.zh: 《晉諸公贊》曰：德字彥孫。
manualTranslations.literal: Accounts of the Lords of Jin says: De's style was Yansun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Accounts of the Lords of Jin says De's style was Yansun.

manualTranslations.zh: 司馬景王輔政，以女妻德。
manualTranslations.literal: When Sima Jingwang held regency, he gave his daughter to De in marriage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sima Jingwang held regency, he gave his daughter to De in marriage.

manualTranslations.zh: 妻早亡，文王復以女繼室，即京兆長公主。
manualTranslations.literal: The wife died early; King Wen again gave a daughter as a successor wife, namely the Princess Chang of Jingzhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the wife died early, King Wen again gave a daughter as a successor wife—the Princess Chang of Jingzhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 景、文二王欲自結於郭后，是以頻繁為婚。
manualTranslations.literal: The two kings Jing and Wen wished to bind themselves to Empress Guo, and therefore repeatedly contracted marriages.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The two kings Jing and Wen wished to bind themselves to Empress Guo, and therefore repeatedly contracted marriages.

manualTranslations.zh: 德雖無才學，而恭謹謙順。
manualTranslations.literal: Although De had no talent or learning, he was reverent, careful, modest, and compliant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although De had no talent or learning, he was reverent, careful, modest, and compliant.

manualTranslations.zh: 甄溫字仲舒，與郭建及德等皆后族，以事宜見寵。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhen Wen's style was Zhongshu; he, Guo Jian, De, and the rest were all empress kin and were favored for affairs of state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhen Wen's style was Zhongshu. He, Guo Jian, De, and the rest were all empress kin and were favored for affairs of state.

manualTranslations.zh: 咸熙初，封郭建為臨渭縣公，德廣安縣公，邑皆千八百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Xianxi, Guo Jian was enfeoffed as Duke of Linwei County and De as Duke of Guang'an County, each with eighteen hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xianxi, Guo Jian was enfeoffed as Duke of Linwei County and De as Duke of Guang'an County, each with eighteen hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 溫本國侯，進為輔國大將軍，加侍中，領射聲校尉，德鎮軍大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Wen was originally a marquis of the founding state; he was advanced to General Who Assists the State, additionally made Palace Attendant, and put in charge as Colonel of the Archers Who Shoot at Sound; De was made General Who Guards the Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wen was originally a marquis of the founding state. He was advanced to General Who Assists the State, additionally made Palace Attendant, and put in charge as Colonel of the Archers Who Shoot at Sound. De was made General Who Guards the Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 泰始元年，晉受禪，加建、德、溫三人位特進。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Taishi, when Jin received the abdication, Jian, De, and Wen were all advanced to Special Advance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taishi 1, when Jin received the abdication, Jian, De, and Wen were all advanced to Special Advance.

manualTranslations.zh: 德為人貞素，加以世祖姊夫，是以遂貴當世。
manualTranslations.literal: De as a man was upright and plain; added to this, he was the brother-in-law of Shizu, and therefore came to be honored in his age.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: De was upright and plain by nature, and as the brother-in-law of Shizu he came to be honored in his age.

manualTranslations.zh: 德暮年官更轉為宗正，遷侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: In De's later years his office was changed to Director of the Imperial Clan, and he was transferred to Palace Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In De's later years he was made Director of the Imperial Clan and transferred to Palace Attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 太康中，大司馬齊王攸當之籓，德與左衛將軍王濟共諫請，時人嘉之。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taikang, when Grand Marshal Prince of Qi You was about to go to his fief, De and Left Guard General Wang Ji jointly remonstrated and petitioned; men of the time praised this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taikang, when Grand Marshal Prince of Qi You was about to go to his fief, De and Left Guard General Wang Ji jointly remonstrated and petitioned, and men of the time praised them.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖以此望德，由此出德為大鴻臚，加侍中、光祿大夫，尋疾薨，贈中軍大將軍，開府侍中如故，諡恭公，子喜嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Shizu on this account looked askance at De; for this reason De was sent out as Grand Herald, additionally made Palace Attendant and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness; soon he died of illness; posthumously he was granted General of the Central Army, with an office and Palace Attendant as before, given the posthumous title Duke Gong, and his son Xi succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizu on this account looked askance at De and sent him out as Grand Herald, additionally making him Palace Attendant and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness. Soon he died of illness. He was posthumously made General of the Central Army with an office and Palace Attendant as before, given the posthumous title Duke Gong, and his son Xi succeeded.

manualTranslations.zh: 喜精粹有器美，歷中書郎、右衛將軍、侍中，位至輔國大將軍，加散騎常侍。
manualTranslations.literal: Xi was refined and possessed fine capacity; he passed through Palace Secretary, Right Guard General, and Palace Attendant, reaching the rank of General Who Assists the State and additionally Regular Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xi was refined and possessed fine capacity. He served as Palace Secretary, Right Guard General, and Palace Attendant, reaching the rank of General Who Assists the State and Regular Attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 喜與國姻親，而經趙王倫、齊王冏事故，能不豫際會，良由其才短，然亦以退靜免之。
manualTranslations.literal: Xi was related by marriage to the state, yet through the affairs of Prince of Zhao Lun and Prince of Qi Jiong he was able not to take part in those encounters—likely because his talent was short, yet he was also spared by retiring into quiet.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xi was related by marriage to the state, yet through the affairs of Prince of Zhao Lun and Prince of Qi Jiong he was able to stay out of those encounters—likely because his talent was limited, but also because retiring into quiet spared him.

manualTranslations.zh: 青龍中，又封后從兄子毅及像弟三人，皆為列侯。
manualTranslations.literal: In Qinglong, the empress's cousin's son Yi and Xiang's three younger brothers were again enfeoffed, all as full marquises.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qinglong, the empress's cousin's son Yi and Xiang's three younger brothers were again enfeoffed, all as full marquises.

manualTranslations.zh: 毅數上疏陳時政，官至越騎校尉。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi repeatedly submitted memorials setting forth current policy and reached the office of Colonel of the Yue Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yi repeatedly submitted memorials on current policy and reached the office of Colonel of the Yue Cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 嘉平中，复封暢子二人為列侯。
manualTranslations.literal: In Jiaping, Chang's two sons were again enfeoffed as full marquises.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jiaping, Chang's two sons were again enfeoffed as full marquises.

manualTranslations.zh: 后兄儼孫女為齊王皇后，后父已沒，封后母為廣樂鄉君。
manualTranslations.literal: The empress's elder brother Yan's granddaughter became empress to the Prince of Qi; the empress's father was already dead, so the empress's mother was enfeoffed as Lady of Guangle Township.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress's elder brother Yan's granddaughter became empress to the Prince of Qi. The empress's father was already dead, so her mother was enfeoffed as Lady of Guangle Township.

manualTranslations.zh: 文德郭皇后，安平廣宗人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Wen-De, née Guo, was a native of Guangzong in Anping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Wen-De of the Guo clan came from Guangzong in Anping.

manualTranslations.zh: 祖世長吏。
manualTranslations.literal: For generations her forebears were chief clerks.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For generations her forebears had served as chief clerks.

manualTranslations.zh: 《魏書》曰：父永，官至南郡太守，諡敬侯。
manualTranslations.literal: The Book of Wei says: her father Yong reached the office of Administrator of Nan Commandery and was given the posthumous title Marquis Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Book of Wei says her father Yong reached the office of Administrator of Nan Commandery and received the posthumous title Marquis Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 母姓董氏，即堂陽君，生三男二女：長男浮，高唐令，次女昱，次即后，后弟都，弟成。
manualTranslations.literal: Her mother was of the Dong clan, namely Lady Tangyang; she bore three sons and two daughters: the eldest son Fu, Magistrate of Gaotang; the second daughter Yu; next was the empress; the empress's younger brothers Du and Cheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Her mother was of the Dong clan, namely Lady Tangyang. She bore three sons and two daughters: the eldest son Fu, Magistrate of Gaotang; the second daughter Yu; next the empress; and the empress's younger brothers Du and Cheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 后以漢中平元年三月乙卯生，生而有異常。
manualTranslations.literal: The empress was born on the yimao day of the third month of the first year of Zhongping of Han; at birth there were unusual signs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress was born on the yimao day of the third month of Han Zhongping 1; at birth there were unusual signs.

manualTranslations.zh: 后少而父永奇之曰：「此乃吾女中王也。」
manualTranslations.literal: When the empress was young her father Yong marveled at her, saying, "This is the king among my daughters."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the empress was young her father Yong marveled at her, saying, "This is the king among my daughters."

manualTranslations.zh: 遂以女王為字。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon he took Nüwang as her style.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereupon he took Nüwang as her style.

manualTranslations.zh: 早失二親，喪亂流離，沒在銅鞮侯家。
manualTranslations.literal: She early lost both parents; in the chaos of mourning and disorder she was cast adrift and ended up in the household of the Marquis of Tongdi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She early lost both parents. In the chaos of war and exile she ended up in the household of the Marquis of Tongdi.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖為魏公時，得入東宮。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor became Duke of Wei, she was able to enter the Eastern Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Grand Ancestor became Duke of Wei, she entered the Eastern Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 后有智數，時時有所獻納。
manualTranslations.literal: The empress had wisdom and calculation and from time to time offered suggestions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress was clever and from time to time offered suggestions.

manualTranslations.zh: 文帝定為嗣，后有謀焉。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wen-di was fixed as heir, the empress had a hand in the plan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wen-di was fixed as heir, the empress had a hand in the plan.

manualTranslations.zh: 太子即王位，后為夫人，及踐阼，為貴嬪。
manualTranslations.literal: When the heir apparent took the royal title, the empress became Lady; when he ascended the throne, she became Honored Consort.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the heir apparent took the royal title, she became Lady; when he ascended the throne, she became Honored Consort.

manualTranslations.zh: 甄后之死，由后之寵也。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Zhen's death came from this empress's favor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Zhen's death came from this empress's favor.

manualTranslations.zh: 黃初三年，將登后位，文帝欲立為后，中郎棧潛上疏曰：「在昔帝王之治天下，不惟外輔，亦有內助，治亂所由，盛衰從之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Huangchu, as she was about to ascend the empress's seat, Wen-di wished to install her as empress; Palace Gentleman Stack Qian submitted a memorial, saying, "In former times when emperors and kings governed the realm, they relied not only on outer assistance but also on inner support; order and disorder arise from this, and rise and decline follow it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Huangchu 3, as she was about to ascend the empress's seat, Wen-di wished to install her as empress. Palace Gentleman Stack Qian submitted a memorial, saying, "In former times when emperors and kings governed the realm, they relied not only on outer assistance but also on inner support; order and disorder arise from this, and rise and decline follow it."

manualTranslations.zh: 故西陵配黃，英娥降媯，並以賢明，流芳上世。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore Xiling was paired with Huang and the heroic maid descended to the Gui clan; all by sage wisdom and clarity, their fragrance flowed in upper ages.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Therefore Xiling was paired with Huang and the heroic maid descended to the Gui clan—all by sage wisdom and clarity, their fame flowed through upper ages.

manualTranslations.zh: 桀奔南巢，禍階末喜；
manualTranslations.literal: Jie fled to Southern Nest and disaster began with Mo Xi;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jie fled to Southern Nest and disaster began with Mo Xi;

manualTranslations.zh: 紂以砲烙，怡悅妲己。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhou used the burning pillar and took delight in Daji.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhou used the burning pillar and took delight in Daji.

manualTranslations.zh: 是以聖哲慎立元妃，必取先代世族之家，擇其令淑以統六宮，虔奉宗廟，陰教聿修。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore the sage and wise are careful in establishing the primary consort; they must take a house of hereditary clans of former ages, choose one who is good and virtuous to govern the six palaces, reverently serve the ancestral temple, and fully cultivate inner instruction.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Therefore the sage and wise are careful in establishing the primary consort. They must take a house of hereditary clans of former ages, choose one who is good and virtuous to govern the six palaces, reverently serve the ancestral temple, and fully cultivate inner instruction.

manualTranslations.zh: 易曰：『家道正而天下定。』
manualTranslations.literal: The Changes says, 'When the way of the family is correct, the realm is settled.'
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Changes says, "When the way of the family is correct, the realm is settled."

manualTranslations.zh: 由內及外，先王之令典也。
manualTranslations.literal: From inner to outer—this is the august norm of the former kings.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From inner to outer—this is the august norm of the former kings.

manualTranslations.zh: 春秋書宗人釁夏云，無以妾為夫人之禮。
manualTranslations.literal: The Spring and Autumn records the Director of the Clan performing the summer offering and says there is no rite for making a concubine a lady.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn records the Director of the Clan performing the summer offering and says there is no rite for making a concubine a lady.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊桓誓命於葵丘，亦曰『無以妾為妻』。
manualTranslations.literal: Duke Huan of Qi swore his command at Kuqiu and likewise said, 'Do not take a concubine as wife.'
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Duke Huan of Qi swore his command at Kuqiu and likewise said, "Do not take a concubine as wife."

manualTranslations.zh: 今后宮嬖寵，常亞乘輿。
manualTranslations.literal: Now in the inner palace favored concubines often rank just below the imperial carriage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now in the inner palace favored concubines often rank just below the imperial carriage.

manualTranslations.zh: 若因愛登后，使賤人暴貴，臣恐後世下陵上替，開張非度，亂自上起也。」
manualTranslations.literal: If through affection one installs her as empress and makes a base person suddenly exalted, I fear that in later ages inferiors will encroach on superiors and the proper order will be overturned, irregular practices will be opened wide, and disorder will rise from above."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If through affection one installs her as empress and makes a base person suddenly exalted, I fear that in later ages inferiors will encroach on superiors, irregular practices will be opened wide, and disorder will rise from above."

manualTranslations.zh: 文帝不從，遂立為皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: Wen-di did not follow this and thereupon installed her as empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wen-di did not follow this and installed her as empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 《魏書》曰：后上表謝曰：「妾無皇、英釐降之節，又非姜、任思齊之倫，誠不足以假充女君之盛位，處中饋之重任。」
manualTranslations.literal: The Book of Wei states: the empress submitted a memorial of thanks, saying, "Your handmaid lacks the virtue of Huang and Ying or the descending grace of Li; nor am I of the same order as Jiang and Ren in aspiring to equal virtue. Truly I am not sufficient to borrow and fill the exalted seat of the female sovereign or bear the heavy charge of the inner kitchen."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Book of Wei says the empress submitted a memorial of thanks, saying, "Your handmaid lacks the virtue of Huang and Ying or the descending grace of Li, nor am I of the same order as Jiang and Ren in aspiring to equal virtue. Truly I am not fit to fill the exalted seat of the female sovereign or bear the heavy charge of the inner household."

manualTranslations.zh: 后自在東宮，及即尊位，雖有異寵，心愈恭肅，供養永壽宮，以孝聞。
manualTranslations.literal: From the time she was in the Eastern Palace until she reached the honored position, although she had special favor, her heart grew ever more reverent and solemn; she supported Yongshou Palace and was known for filial piety.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From the Eastern Palace until she reached the honored position, although she had special favor, her heart grew ever more reverent and solemn. She supported Yongshou Palace and was known for filial piety.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時柴貴人亦有寵，后教訓獎導之。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Honored Lady Chai also had favor; the empress instructed, exhorted, and guided her.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time Honored Lady Chai also had favor, and the empress instructed, exhorted, and guided her.

manualTranslations.zh: 后宮諸貴人時有過失，常彌覆之，有譴讓，輒為帝言其本末，帝或大有所怒，至為之頓首請罪，是以六宮無怨。
manualTranslations.literal: When the various honored ladies of the inner palace at times had faults, she constantly covered them over; when there was reproof or censure, she would explain the whole matter to the emperor; the emperor might become greatly angry, even to the point that she would kowtow and plead guilt—thus the six palaces were without resentment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the various honored ladies of the inner palace at times had faults, she constantly covered them over. When there was reproof or censure, she would explain the whole matter to the emperor. The emperor might become greatly angry, even to the point that she would kowtow and plead guilt—thus the six palaces were without resentment.

manualTranslations.zh: 性儉約，不好音樂，常慕漢明德馬后之為人。
manualTranslations.literal: By nature she was frugal and restrained, disliked music, and constantly admired the conduct of Empress Ma the Bright and Virtuous of Han.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By nature she was frugal and restrained, disliked music, and constantly admired the conduct of Empress Ma the Bright and Virtuous of Han.

sourceRange.text: ，帝遊后園，召才人以上曲宴極樂。

localRange.text: 景初元年，帝遊后園，召才人以上曲宴極樂。

context.beforeSource: 帝之幸郭元后也，后愛寵日弛。
context.afterSource: 元后曰「宜延皇后」，帝弗許。
context.beforeLocal: 帝之幸郭元后也，后愛寵日弛。
context.afterLocal: 元后曰「宜延皇后」，帝弗許。

sourceRange.text: 」明帝即位，尊后為皇太后，稱永安宮。太和四年，詔封表安陽亭侯，又進爵鄉侯，增邑並前五百戶，遷中壘將軍。以表子詳為騎都尉。其年，帝追諡太后父永為安陽鄉敬侯，母董為都鄉君。遷表昭德將軍，加金紫，位特進，表第二子訓為騎都尉。及孟武母卒，欲厚葬，起祠堂，太后止之曰：「自喪亂以來，墳墓無不發掘，皆由厚葬也；首陽陵可以為法。」青龍三年春，后崩於許昌，以終制營陵，三月庚寅，葬首陽陵西。《魏略》曰：明帝既嗣立，追痛甄后之薨，故太后以憂暴崩。甄后臨沒，以帝屬李夫人。及太后崩，夫人乃說甄后見譖之禍，不獲大斂，被髮覆面，帝哀恨流涕，命殯葬太后，皆如甄后故事。漢晉春秋曰：初，甄后之誅，由郭后之寵，及殯，令被髮覆面，以糠塞口，遂立郭后，使養明帝。帝知之，心常懷忿，數泣問甄后死狀。郭后曰：「先帝自殺，何以責問我？且汝為人子，可追讎死父，為前母枉殺後母邪？」明帝怒，遂逼殺之，敕殯者使如甄后故事。《魏書》載哀策曰：「維青龍三年三月壬申，皇太后梓宮啟殯，將葬於首陽之西陵。哀子皇帝叡親奉冊祖載，遂親遣奠，叩心擗踴，號咷仰訴，痛靈魂之遷幸，悲容車之向路，背三光以潛翳，就黃壚而安厝。嗚呼哀哉！昔二女妃虞，帝道以彰，三母嬪週，聖善彌光，既多受祉，享國延長。哀哀慈妣，興化閏房，龍飛紫極，作合聖皇，不虞中年，暴罹災殃。愍予小子，煢煢摧傷，魂雖永逝，定省曷望？嗚呼哀哉！」帝進表爵為觀津侯，增邑五百，並前千戶。遷詳為駙馬都尉。四年，追改封永為觀津敬侯，世婦董為堂陽君。追封諡后兄浮為梁裡亭戴侯，都為武城亭孝侯，成為新樂亭定侯，皆使使者奉策，祠以太牢。詳薨，子釗嗣。

manualTranslations.zh: 」明帝即位，尊后為皇太后，稱永安宮。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Ming ascended the throne he honored the empress as Empress Dowager, with her residence called Yong'an Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Ming-di succeeded he raised the empress to Empress Dowager of Yong'an Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 太和四年，詔封表安陽亭侯，又進爵鄉侯，增邑並前五百戶，遷中壘將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Taihe an edict enfeoffed Biao as Marquis of Anyang Pavilion, then advanced his rank to village marquis, added five hundred households to his fief together with what he already held, and transferred him to General of the Central Rampart.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taihe 4 an edict made Guo Biao Marquis of Anyang Pavilion, then promoted him to village marquis, added five hundred households to his fief for a total with prior holdings, and appointed him general of the central rampart.

manualTranslations.zh: 以表子詳為騎都尉。
manualTranslations.literal: He appointed Biao's son Xiang as Cavalry Commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He made Biao's son Guo Xiang cavalry commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年，帝追諡太后父永為安陽鄉敬侯，母董為都鄉君。
manualTranslations.literal: That year the emperor posthumously honored the empress dowager's father Yong as Marquis Jing of Anyang Village and her mother Dong as Mistress of the Capital Village.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That same year the emperor posthumously ennobled the empress dowager's father Yong as Marquis Jing of Anyang village and her mother Dong as lady of the capital village.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷表昭德將軍，加金紫，位特進，表第二子訓為騎都尉。
manualTranslations.literal: Biao was transferred to General Who Displays Virtue, given the gold seal and purple ribbon, granted the position of Special Advance, and Biao's second son Xun was made Cavalry Commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo Biao was promoted to general who displays virtue, given the gold seal and purple cord and the rank of special advance; Biao's second son Xun became cavalry commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 及孟武母卒，欲厚葬，起祠堂，太后止之曰：「自喪亂以來，墳墓無不發掘，皆由厚葬也；
manualTranslations.literal: When Meng Wu's mother died and he wished a lavish burial and to erect an ancestral hall, the empress dowager stopped him, saying, "Since the disorders of war, tombs have all been opened and plundered—all because of lavish burial;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Meng Wu's mother died and he wanted a lavish funeral and an ancestral shrine, the empress dowager forbade it, saying, "Since the age of chaos no tomb has escaped looting, and lavish burial is always the reason;

manualTranslations.zh: 首陽陵可以為法。」
manualTranslations.literal: Shouyang Mausoleum may serve as the model."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Take Shouyang Mausoleum as your model."

manualTranslations.zh: 青龍三年春，后崩於許昌，以終制營陵，三月庚寅，葬首陽陵西。
manualTranslations.literal: In the spring of the third year of Qinglong the empress dowager died at Xuchang; following the final rites a mausoleum was built, and on gengyin in the third month she was buried west of Shouyang Mausoleum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of Qinglong 3 the empress dowager died at Xuchang. A tomb was built according to the prescribed mourning rites, and on gengyin of the third month she was buried west of Shouyang Mausoleum.

manualTranslations.zh: 《魏略》曰：明帝既嗣立，追痛甄后之薨，故太后以憂暴崩。
manualTranslations.literal: The Wei Summary states: Once Emperor Ming had succeeded to the throne and grieved anew for Empress Zhen's death, the empress dowager therefore died suddenly from distress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Wei Summary says that once Ming-di had succeeded and was again mourning Empress Wen-Zhao's death, the empress dowager died suddenly of grief.

manualTranslations.zh: 甄后臨沒，以帝屬李夫人。
manualTranslations.literal: When Empress Zhen was near death she entrusted the emperor to Lady Li.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As Empress Wen-Zhao lay dying she entrusted the emperor to Lady Li.

manualTranslations.zh: 及太后崩，夫人乃說甄后見譖之禍，不獲大斂，被髮覆面，帝哀恨流涕，命殯葬太后，皆如甄后故事。
manualTranslations.literal: When the empress dowager died Lady Li then told how Empress Zhen had suffered slander and calamity, had not received full encoffinment, and had been left with hair loose and face covered; the emperor mourned and wept in bitter regret and ordered that the empress dowager's funeral and burial follow Empress Zhen's precedent in every respect.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the empress dowager died, Lady Li recounted how Empress Wen-Zhao had been slandered to her ruin, denied proper encoffinment, and left with hair loose over her face. The emperor wept in grief and rage and ordered the empress dowager's funeral handled exactly as Empress Wen-Zhao's had been.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢晉春秋曰：初，甄后之誅，由郭后之寵，及殯，令被髮覆面，以糠塞口，遂立郭后，使養明帝。
manualTranslations.literal: Spring and Autumn of Han and Jin states: At first Empress Zhen's execution came from Empress Guo's favor; at the encoffinment she was made to let her hair hang and cover her face, with chaff stuffed in her mouth; then Empress Guo was established and made to rear Emperor Ming.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn of Han and Jin records that Empress Wen-Zhao was put to death because of Empress Wen-De's favor; at burial her hair was left loose over her face and chaff was stuffed in her mouth. Empress Wen-De was then enthroned and charged with raising Ming-di.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝知之，心常懷忿，數泣問甄后死狀。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor knew this and constantly harbored resentment, weeping again and again as he asked how Empress Zhen had died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ming-di knew this and nursed a lasting grievance, weeping repeatedly as he questioned how Empress Wen-Zhao had died.

manualTranslations.zh: 郭后曰：「先帝自殺，何以責問我？
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Guo said, "The former emperor killed himself—why do you hold me to account?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Wen-De answered, "The late emperor took his own life—why blame me?

manualTranslations.zh: 且汝為人子，可追讎死父，為前母枉殺後母邪？」
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, as a son, can you pursue vengeance for a dead father and wrongly kill your stepmother for your former mother?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: And as his son, would you avenge a dead father by killing your stepmother for your birth mother's sake?"

manualTranslations.zh: 明帝怒，遂逼殺之，敕殯者使如甄后故事。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Ming grew angry, then forced her to death, and instructed those handling the encoffinment to follow Empress Zhen's precedent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ming-di flew into a rage, forced her to her death, and ordered the embalmers to treat her exactly as Empress Wen-Zhao had been treated.

manualTranslations.zh: 《魏書》載哀策曰：「維青龍三年三月壬申，皇太后梓宮啟殯，將葬於首陽之西陵。
manualTranslations.literal: The Book of Wei records the lamentation patent, saying, "In the third year of Qinglong, on the third month, day renshen, the empress dowager's coffin was opened for encoffinment and was to be buried at the western mausoleum of Shouyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Book of Wei preserves the lamentation patent: "In Qinglong 3, on renshen of the third month, the empress dowager's coffin was opened for burial at the western tomb of Shouyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 哀子皇帝叡親奉冊祖載，遂親遣奠，叩心擗踴，號咷仰訴，痛靈魂之遷幸，悲容車之向路，背三光以潛翳，就黃壚而安厝。
manualTranslations.literal: The grieving son, Emperor Rui, personally bore the patent and ancestral carriage, then personally sent forth offerings, beating his breast and stamping in grief, wailing and crying heavenward in appeal, pained that the spirit soul was being removed in favor, grieved that the bier was setting out on its road, turning his back on the three luminaries as they dimmed in concealment, and coming to the yellow mound for peaceful rest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The grieving son, Emperor Rui, personally bore the patent and ancestral carriage, then offered sacrifice himself—beating his breast, stamping in anguish, wailing heavenward—mourning the spirit's departure, grieving the bier's journey, turning from the sun, moon, and stars now dimmed, and committing her to the yellow earth in peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！
manualTranslations.literal: Alas, how mournful!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Alas, how mournful!

manualTranslations.zh: 昔二女妃虞，帝道以彰，三母嬪週，聖善彌光，既多受祉，享國延長。
manualTranslations.literal: In antiquity two daughters became consorts of Yu and the imperial way was thereby made manifest; three mothers entered the Zhou house and sagely goodness shone ever brighter; they received abundant blessing and their states endured long.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Long ago two daughters wed into Yu's line and the imperial way shone forth; three mothers entered Zhou and sanctity grew ever brighter—they received great blessing and their realms endured.

manualTranslations.zh: 哀哀慈妣，興化閏房，龍飛紫極，作合聖皇，不虞中年，暴罹災殃。
manualTranslations.literal: Mournful, mournful is my gracious mother, who raised transforming influence within the inner chambers, rose with the dragon to the purple apex, and was paired with the sage emperor—yet who did not expect mid-life and suddenly met calamity and disaster.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mournful is my gracious mother, who nurtured virtue in the inner chambers, rose to the purple throne beside the sage emperor, and yet, in mid-life, was suddenly struck by disaster.

manualTranslations.zh: 愍予小子，煢煢摧傷，魂雖永逝，定省曷望？
manualTranslations.literal: Pity me, this little child, lonely and broken in grief; though the soul has forever departed, how can I still hope for morning and evening attendance?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Pity me, a lonely child crushed with grief; though her soul is gone forever, how can I ever again attend her morning and evening?

manualTranslations.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！」
manualTranslations.literal: Alas, how mournful!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Alas, how mournful!"

manualTranslations.zh: 帝進表爵為觀津侯，增邑五百，並前千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor advanced Biao's noble rank to Marquis of Guanjin, added five hundred households to his fief, making one thousand together with what he already held.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor promoted Guo Biao to Marquis of Guanjin, added five hundred households to his fief, and brought his total holdings to one thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷詳為駙馬都尉。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiang was transferred to Commandant of the Stable for the Son-in-Law.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo Xiang was made commandant of the stable for the emperor's son-in-law.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，追改封永為觀津敬侯，世婦董為堂陽君。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year Yong was posthumously re-enfeoffed as Marquis Jing of Guanjin and the late wife Dong as Mistress of Tangyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Yong was posthumously re-enfeoffed as Marquis Jing of Guanjin and the late wife Dong as lady of Tangyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 追封諡后兄浮為梁裡亭戴侯，都為武城亭孝侯，成為新樂亭定侯，皆使使者奉策，祠以太牢。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumously enfeoffing and honoring the empress's elder brothers, Fu was made Marquis Dai of Liangli Pavilion, Du Marquis Xiao of Wucheng Pavilion, and Cheng Marquis Ding of Xinle Pavilion; envoys were sent to each bearing patents, and they were sacrificed to with the grand offering.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress dowager's brothers were posthumously ennobled: Fu as Marquis Dai of Liangli pavilion, Du as Marquis Xiao of Wucheng pavilion, and Cheng as Marquis Ding of Xinle pavilion. Envoys were dispatched with patents to sacrifice to each with the grand offering.

manualTranslations.zh: 詳薨，子釗嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiang died, and his son Zhao succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo Xiang died and was succeeded by his son Zhao.

sourceRange.text: 明元郭皇后，西平人也，世河右大族。黃初中，本郡反叛，遂沒入宮。明帝即位，甚見愛幸，拜為夫人。叔父立為騎都尉，從父芝為虎賁中郎將。帝疾困，遂立為皇后。齊王即位，尊后為皇太后，稱永寧宮，追封諡太后父滿為西都定侯，以立子建紹其爵。封太后母杜為郃陽君。芝遷散騎常侍、長水校尉，《魏略》曰：諸郭之中，芝最壯直。先時自以他功封侯。立，宣德將軍，皆封列侯。建兄德，出養甄氏。德及建俱為鎮護將軍，皆封列侯，並掌宿衛。值三主幼弱，宰輔統政，與奪大事，皆先諮啟於太后而後施行。毌丘儉、鍾會等作亂，咸假其命而以為辭焉。景元四年十二日崩，五年二月，葬高平陵西。《晉諸公贊》曰：建字叔始，有器局而強問，泰始中疾薨。子嘏嗣，為給事中。

localRange.text: 明元郭皇后【評】

context.afterSource: 評曰：魏后妃之家，雖云富貴，未有若衰漢乘非其據，宰割朝政者也。

manualTranslations.zh: 明元郭皇后，西平人也，世河右大族。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Ming-Yuan of the Guo clan was a native of Xiping and for generations a great clan west of the Yellow River.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Ming-Yuan of the Guo clan came from Xiping; her family was a great house west of the Yellow River for generations.

manualTranslations.zh: 黃初中，本郡反叛，遂沒入宮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Huangchu era the commandery rebelled, and she was then taken into the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Huangchu her commandery rebelled, and she was taken into the palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 明帝即位，甚見愛幸，拜為夫人。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Ming ascended the throne she was greatly favored and invested as Lady.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once Ming-di succeeded she won great favor and was made Lady.

manualTranslations.zh: 叔父立為騎都尉，從父芝為虎賁中郎將。
manualTranslations.literal: Her father's younger brother Li was appointed Cavalry Commandant; her father's cousin Zhi was made Colonel of the Tiger Guards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Her uncle Li became cavalry commandant and her father's cousin Guo Zhi colonel of the tiger guards.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝疾困，遂立為皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: When the emperor was gravely ill she was then established as empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor fell gravely ill she was enthroned as empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊王即位，尊后為皇太后，稱永寧宮，追封諡太后父滿為西都定侯，以立子建紹其爵。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Prince of Qi ascended the throne he honored her as Empress Dowager, with her residence called Yongning Palace; he posthumously enfeoffed and honored the empress dowager's father Man as Marquis Ding of Xidu, and had his son Jian continue his noble rank.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Cao Fang succeeded he raised her to Empress Dowager of Yongning Palace, posthumously ennobled her father Man as Marquis Ding of Xidu, and had his son Jian inherit the title.

manualTranslations.zh: 封太后母杜為郃陽君。
manualTranslations.literal: The empress dowager's mother Du was enfeoffed as Mistress of Heyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Her mother Du was enfeoffed as lady of Heyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 芝遷散騎常侍、長水校尉，《魏略》曰：諸郭之中，芝最壯直。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhi was transferred to Regular Palace Attendant and Colonel of the Changshui Guard; the Wei Summary states: Among all the Guo clan, Zhi was the most forceful and upright.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo Zhi was promoted to regular palace attendant and colonel of the Changshui guard. The Wei Summary says that among the Guo clan Zhi was the most forceful and upright.

manualTranslations.zh: 先時自以他功封侯。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier he had on other merit been enfeoffed as marquis.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had earlier been enfeoffed as marquis on other merits.

manualTranslations.zh: 立，宣德將軍，皆封列侯。
manualTranslations.literal: Li was made General Who Displays Virtue; both were enfeoffed as full marquises.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li was made general who displays virtue; both were enfeoffed as full marquises.

manualTranslations.zh: 建兄德，出養甄氏。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian's elder brother De had been given out in adoption to the Zhen clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian's elder brother De had been given in adoption to the Zhen clan.

manualTranslations.zh: 德及建俱為鎮護將軍，皆封列侯，並掌宿衛。
manualTranslations.literal: De and Jian were both made Generals Who Guard the Garrisons, all enfeoffed as full marquises, and together held command of the palace guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: De and Jian both became generals who guard the garrisons, were enfeoffed as full marquises, and jointly commanded the palace guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 值三主幼弱，宰輔統政，與奪大事，皆先諮啟於太后而後施行。
manualTranslations.literal: It happened that three rulers were young and weak and chief ministers held unified government; in granting and taking away great affairs all first consulted and reported to the empress dowager and only then were carried out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With three successive child emperors and regents holding power, every major appointment or dismissal was first reported to the empress dowager before it was enacted.

manualTranslations.zh: 毌丘儉、鍾會等作亂，咸假其命而以為辭焉。
manualTranslations.literal: When Guanqiu Jian, Zhong Hui, and others raised rebellion, they all borrowed her command and used it as their pretext.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Guanqiu Jian, Zhong Hui, and others rebelled, they all invoked her authority as their pretext.

manualTranslations.zh: 景元四年十二日崩，五年二月，葬高平陵西。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of Jingyuan she died; in the second month of the fifth year she was buried west of Gaoping Mausoleum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She died in the twelfth month of Jingyuan 4 and was buried west of Gaoping Mausoleum in the second month of the following year.

sourceRange.text: 靈帝崩，少帝即位。大將軍何進與司隷校尉袁紹謀誅諸閹官，太后不從。進乃召卓使將兵詣京師，并密令上書曰：「中常侍張讓等竊幸乘寵，濁亂海內。昔趙鞅興晉陽之甲，以逐君側之惡。臣輙鳴鍾鼓如洛陽，即討讓等。」欲以脅迫太后。卓未至，進敗。《續漢書》曰：進字遂高，南陽人，太后異母兄也。進本屠家子，父曰真。真死後，進以妹倚黃門得入掖庭，有寵，光和三年立爲皇后，進由是貴幸。中平元年，黃巾起，拜進大將軍。《典略》載卓表曰：「臣伏惟天下所以有逆不止者，各由黃門常侍張讓等侮慢天常，操擅王命，父子兄弟並據州郡，一書出門，便獲千金，京畿諸郡數百萬膏腴美田皆屬讓等，至使怨氣上蒸，妖賊蠭起。臣前奉詔討於扶羅，將士饑乏，不肯渡河，皆言欲詣京師先誅閹豎以除民害，從臺閣求乞資直。臣隨慰撫，以至新安。臣聞揚湯止沸，不如滅火去薪，潰癕雖痛，勝於養肉，及溺呼船，悔之無及。」中常侍段珪等劫帝走小平津，卓遂將其衆迎帝于北芒，還宮。張璠《漢紀》曰：帝以八月庚午爲諸黃門所劫，步出穀門，走至河上。諸黃門旣投河死。時帝年十四，陳留王年九歲，兄弟獨夜步行欲還宮，闇暝，逐螢火而行，數里，得民家以露車載送。辛未，公卿以下與卓共迎帝於北芒阪下。《獻帝春秋》曰：先是童謠曰：「侯非侯，王非王，千乘萬騎走北芒。」卓時適至，屯顯陽苑。聞帝當還，率衆迎帝。《典略》曰：帝望見卓兵涕泣。羣公謂卓曰：「有詔郤兵。」卓曰：「公諸人爲國大臣，不能匡正王室，至使國家播蕩，何郤兵之有！」遂俱入城。《獻帝紀》曰：卓與帝語，語不可了。乃更與陳留王語，問禍亂由起；王荅，自初至終，無所遺失。卓大喜，乃有廢立意。《英雄記》曰：河南中部掾閔貢扶帝及陳留王上至雒舍止。帝獨乘一馬，陳留王與貢共乘一馬，從雒舍南行。公卿百官奉迎於北芒阪下，故太尉崔烈在前導。卓將步騎數千來迎，烈呵使避，卓罵烈曰：「晝夜三百里來，何云避，我不能斷卿頭邪？」前見帝曰：「陛下令常侍小黃門作亂乃爾，以取禍敗，爲負不小邪？」又趨陳留王，曰：「我董卓也，從我抱來。」乃於貢抱中取王。《英雄記》曰：一本云王不就卓抱，卓與王併馬而行也。時進弟車騎將軍苗爲進衆所殺，《英雄記》云：苗，太后之同母兄，先嫁朱氏之子。進部曲將吳匡，素怨苗不與進同心，又疑其與宦官通謀，乃令軍中曰：「殺大將軍者，車騎也。」遂引兵與卓弟旻共攻殺苗於朱爵闕下。進、苗部曲無所屬，皆詣卓。卓又使呂布殺執金吾丁原，并其衆，故京都兵權唯在卓。《九州春秋》曰：卓初入洛陽，步騎不過三千，自嫌兵少，不爲遠近所服；率四五日，輙夜遣兵出四城門，明日陳旌鼓而入，宣言云「西兵復入至洛中」。人不覺，謂卓兵不可勝數。

河內太守王匡遣泰山兵屯河陽津，將以圖卓。卓遣疑兵若將於平陰渡者，潛遣銳衆從小平北渡，繞擊其後，大破之津北，死者略盡。卓以山東豪傑並起，恐懼不寧。初平元年二月，乃徙天子都長安。焚燒洛陽宮室，悉發掘陵墓，取寶物。華嶠《漢書》曰：卓欲遷都長安，召公卿以下大議。司徒楊彪曰：「昔盤庚五遷，殷民胥怨，故作三篇以曉天下之民。今海內安穩，無故移都，恐百姓驚動，麋沸蟻聚爲亂。」卓曰：「關中肥饒，故秦得并吞六國。今徙西京，設令關東豪彊敢有動者，以我彊兵踧之，可使詣滄海。」彪曰：「海內動之甚易，安之甚難。又長安宮室壞敗，不可卒復。」卓曰：「武帝時居杜陵南山下，有成瓦窑數千處，引涼州材木東下以作宮室，爲功不難。」卓意不得，便作色曰：「公欲沮我計邪？邊章、韓約有書來，欲令朝廷必徙都。若大兵來下，我不能復相救，公便可與袁氏西行。」彪曰：「西方自彪道徑也，顧未知天下何如耳！」議罷。卓勑司隷校尉宣璠以災異劾奏，因策免彪。《續漢書》曰：太尉黃琬、司徒楊彪、司空荀爽俱詣卓，卓言：「昔高祖都關中，十一世後中興，更都洛陽。從光武至今復十一世，案石苞室讖，宜復還都長安。」坐中皆驚愕，無敢應者。彪曰：「遷都改制，天下大事，皆當因民之心，隨時之宜。昔盤庚五遷，殷民胥怨，故作三篇以曉之。往者王莽篡逆，變亂五常，更始赤眉之時，焚燒長安，殘害百姓，民人流亡，百無一在。光武受命，更都洛邑，此其宜也。今方建立聖主，光隆漢祚，而無故捐宮廟，棄園陵，恐百姓驚愕，不解此意，必麋沸蟻聚以致擾亂。石苞室讖，妖邪之書，豈可信用？」卓作色曰：「楊公欲沮國家計邪？關東方亂，所在賊起。崤函險固，國之重防。又隴右取材，功夫不難。杜陵南山下有孝武故陶處，作塼瓦，一朝可辦。宮室官府，蓋何足言！百姓小民，何足與議。若有前郤，我以大兵驅之，豈得自在。」百寮恐怖失色。琬謂卓曰：「此大事。楊公之語，得無重思！」卓罷坐，即日令司隷奏彪及琬，皆免官。大駕即西。卓部兵燒洛陽城外面百里。又自將兵燒南北宮及宗廟、府庫、民家，城內埽地殄盡。又收諸富室，以罪惡沒入其財物；無辜而死者，不可勝計。《獻帝紀》曰：卓獲山東兵，以豬膏塗布十餘匹，用纏其身，然後燒之，先從足起。獲袁紹豫州從事李延，煑殺之。卓所愛胡，恃寵放縱，爲司隷校尉趙謙所殺。卓大怒曰：「我愛狗，尚不欲令人呵之，而況人乎！」乃召司隷都官撾殺之。卓至西京，爲太師，號曰尚父。乘青蓋金華車，爪畫兩轓，時人號曰竿摩車。《魏書》曰：言其逼天子也。《獻帝紀》曰：卓旣爲太師，復欲稱尚父，以問蔡邕。邕曰：「昔武王受命，太公爲師，輔佐周室，以伐無道，是以天下尊之，稱爲尚父。今公之功德誠爲巍巍，宜須關東悉定，車駕東還，然後議之。」乃止。京師地震，卓又問邕。邕對曰：「地動陰盛，大臣踰制之所致也。公乘青蓋車，遠近以爲非宜。」卓從之，更乘金華皂蓋車也。卓弟旻爲左將軍，封鄠侯；兄子璜爲侍中中軍校尉典兵；宗族內外並列朝廷。《英雄記》曰：卓侍妾懷抱中子，皆封侯，弄以金紫。孫女名白，時尚未笄，封爲渭陽君。於郿城東起壇，從廣二丈餘，高五六尺，使白乘軒金華青蓋車，都尉、中郎將、刺史二千石在郿者，各令乘軒簪筆，爲白導從，之壇上，使兄子璜爲使者授印綬。公卿見卓，謁拜車下，卓不爲禮。召呼三臺尚書以下自詣卓府啟事。《山陽公載記》曰：初卓爲前將軍，皇甫嵩爲左將軍，俱征韓遂，各不相下。後卓徵爲少府并州牧，兵當屬嵩，卓大怒。及爲太師，嵩爲御史中丞，拜於車下。卓問嵩：「義真服未乎？」嵩曰：「安知明公乃至於是！」卓曰：「鴻鵠固有遠志，但燕雀自不知耳。」嵩曰：「昔與明公俱爲鴻鵠，不意今日變爲鳳皇耳。」卓笑曰：「卿早服，今日可不拜也。」張璠《漢紀》曰：卓抵其手謂皇甫嵩曰：「義真怖未乎？」嵩對曰：「明公以德輔朝廷，大慶方至，何怖之有？若淫刑以逞，將天下皆懼，豈獨嵩乎？」卓默然，遂與嵩和解。築郿塢，高與長安城埒，積穀爲三十年儲，《英雄記》曰：郿去長安二百六十里。云事成，雄據天下，不成，守此足以畢老。甞至郿行塢，公卿已下祖道於橫門外。橫音光。卓豫施帳幔飲，誘降北地反者數百人，於坐中先斷其舌，或斬手足，或鑿眼，或鑊煑之，未死，偃轉杯案閒，會者皆戰慄亡失匕箸，而卓飲食自若。太史望氣，言當有大臣戮死者。故太尉張溫時爲衞尉，素不善卓，卓心怨之，因天有變，欲以塞咎，使人言溫與袁術交關，遂笞殺之。《傅子》曰：靈帝時牓門賣官，於是太尉段熲、司徒崔烈、太尉樊陵、司空張溫之徒，皆入錢上千萬下五百萬以買三公。熲數征伐有大功，烈有北州重名，溫有傑才，陵能偶時，皆一時顯士，猶以貨取位，而況於劉嚻、唐珍、張顥之黨乎！風俗通曰：司隷劉嚻以黨諸常侍，致位公輔。《續漢書》曰：唐珍，中常侍唐衡弟。張顥，中常侍張奉弟。法令苛酷，愛憎淫刑，更相被誣，冤死者千數。百姓嗷嗷，道路以目。《魏書》曰：卓使司隷校尉劉嚻籍吏民有爲子不孝，爲臣不忠，爲吏不清，爲弟不順，有應此者皆身誅，財物沒官。於是愛憎互起，民多冤死。悉椎破銅人、鍾虡，及壞五銖錢。更鑄爲小錢，大五分，無文章，肉好無輪郭，不磨鑢。於是貨輕而物貴，穀一斛至數十萬。自是後錢貨不行。

sourceRange.text: 呂布之捨袁紹從張楊也，過邈臨別，把手共誓。紹聞之，大恨。邈畏太祖終爲紹擊己也，心不自安。興平元年194年，太祖復征謙，邈弟超，與太祖將陳宮、從事中郎許汜、王楷共謀叛太祖。宮說邈曰：「今雄傑並起，天下分崩，君以千里之衆，當四戰之地，撫劒顧眄，亦足以爲人豪，而反制於人，不以鄙乎！今州軍東征，其處空虛，呂布壯士，善戰無前，若權迎之，共牧兖州，觀天下形勢，俟時事之變通，此亦縱橫之一時也。」邈從之。太祖初使宮將兵留屯東郡，遂以其衆東迎布爲兖州牧，據濮陽。郡縣皆應，唯鄄城、東阿、范爲太祖守。太祖引軍還，與布戰於濮陽，太祖軍不利，相持百餘日。是時歲旱、蟲蝗、少穀，百姓相食，布東屯山陽。二年間，太祖乃盡復收諸城，擊破布於鉅野。布東奔劉備。

With a host of a thousand li in a land fought over from four sides, you need only grip your sword and look about to be a lord among men—yet you submit to another's control. Is that not shameful?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chen Gong told Zhang Miao: "Heroes are rising everywhere and the realm is splitting apart. With a host of a thousand li in a land fought over from four sides, you need only grip your sword and look about to be a lord among men—yet you submit to another's control. Is that not shameful?

manualTranslations.zh: 今州軍東征，其處空虛，呂布壯士，善戰無前，若權迎之，共牧兖州，觀天下形勢，俟時事之變通，此亦縱橫之一時也。」
manualTranslations.literal: The provincial army is campaigning east and the place is empty. Lü Bu is a fierce warrior, peerless in battle. If you seize the moment and welcome him to jointly govern Yan Province, watch the shape of the realm, and await the shifts of affairs—this too is a season for maneuver."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Cao's army is campaigning east and the province is empty. Lü Bu is a fierce warrior, peerless in battle. Welcome him for the moment, govern Yan Province together, watch the realm's shape, and await shifting fortunes—this too is a season for maneuver."

manualTranslations.zh: 邈從之。
manualTranslations.literal: Miao followed this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhang Miao agreed.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖初使宮將兵留屯東郡，遂以其衆東迎布爲兖州牧，據濮陽。
manualTranslations.literal: Grand Progenitor had earlier sent Gong to lead troops and remain garrisoned in Dong Commandery; he now took his forces east to welcome Bu as Governor of Yan Province and seized Puyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Cao had earlier left Chen Gong to garrison Dong Commandery; Chen Gong now led those troops east to welcome Lü Bu as Governor of Yan Province and seized Puyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 郡縣皆應，唯鄄城、東阿、范爲太祖守。
manualTranslations.literal: The counties and districts all responded; only Juancheng, Dong'e, and Fan remained loyal to Grand Progenitor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The counties and districts all responded; only Juancheng, Dong'e, and Fan held for Cao Cao.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖引軍還，與布戰於濮陽，太祖軍不利，相持百餘日。
manualTranslations.literal: Grand Progenitor brought his army back and fought Bu at Puyang; Grand Progenitor's army fared poorly and they remained locked for over a hundred days.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Cao brought his army back and fought Lü Bu at Puyang; Cao Cao's army fared poorly and they remained locked for over a hundred days.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時歲旱、蟲蝗、少穀，百姓相食，布東屯山陽。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time drought, locusts, and scarce grain drove the people to cannibalism; Bu encamped east at Shanyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Drought, locusts, and famine drove the people to cannibalism; Lü Bu encamped east at Shanyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年間，太祖乃盡復收諸城，擊破布於鉅野。
manualTranslations.literal: Within two years Grand Progenitor recovered every city and defeated Bu at Juye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Within two years Cao Cao recovered every city and defeated Lü Bu at Juye.

manualTranslations.zh: 布東奔劉備。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu fled east to Liu Bei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu fled east to Liu Bei.

sourceRange.text: 備東擊術，布襲取下邳，備還歸布。布遣備屯小沛。布自稱徐州刺史。*|《英雄記》曰：布初入徐州，書與袁術。術報書曰：「昔董卓作亂，破壞王室，禍害術門戶，術舉兵關東，未能屠裂卓。將軍誅卓，送其頭首，爲術掃滅讐耻，使術明目於當世，死生不愧，其功一也。昔將金元休向兖州，甫詣封，爲曹操逆所拒破，流離迸走，幾至滅亡。將軍破兖州，術復明目於遐邇，其功二也。術生年已來，不聞天下有劉備，備乃舉兵與術對戰；術憑將軍威靈，得以破備，其功三也。將軍有三大功在術，術雖不敏，奉以生死。將軍連年攻戰，軍糧苦少，今送米二十萬斛，迎逢道路，非直此止，當駱驛復致；若兵器戰具，佗所乏少，大小唯命。」布得書大喜，遂造下邳。《典略》曰：元休名尚，京兆人也。尚與同郡韋休甫、第五文休俱著名，號爲三休。尚，獻帝初爲兖州刺史，東之郡，而太祖已臨兖州。尚南依袁術。術僭號，欲以尚爲太尉，不敢顯言，私使人諷之，尚無屈意，術亦不敢彊也。建安初，尚逃還，爲術所害。其後尚喪與太傅馬日磾喪俱至京師，天子嘉尚忠烈，爲之咨嗟，詔百官弔祭，拜子瑋郎中，而日磾不與焉。《英雄記》曰：布水陸東下，軍到下邳西四十里。備中郎將丹楊許耽夜遣司馬章誑來詣布，言「張益德與下邳相曹豹共爭，益德殺豹，城中大亂，不相信。丹楊兵有千人屯西白城門內，聞將軍來東，大小踊躍，如復更生。將軍兵向城西門，丹楊軍便開門內將軍矣」。布遂夜進，晨到城下。天明，丹楊兵悉開門內布兵。布於門上坐，步騎放火，大破益德兵，獲備妻子軍資及部曲將吏士家口。建安元年六月夜半時，布將河內郝萌反，將兵入布所治下邳府，詣廳事閤外，同聲大呼攻閤，閤堅不得入。布不知反者爲誰，直牽婦，科頭袒衣，相將從溷上排壁出，詣都督高順營，直排順門入。順問：「將軍有所隱不？」布言「河內兒聲」。順言「此郝萌也」。順即嚴兵入府，弓弩並射萌衆；萌衆亂走，天明還故營。萌將曹性反萌，與對戰，萌刺傷性，性斫萌一臂。順斫萌首，牀輿性，送詣布。布問性，言「萌受袁術謀，謀者悉誰？」性言「陳宮同謀。」時宮在坐上，靣赤，傍人悉覺之。布以宮大將，不問也。性言「萌常以此問，性言呂將軍大將有神，不可擊也，不意萌狂惑不止。」布謂性曰：「卿健兒也！」善養視之。創愈，使安撫萌故營，領其衆。術遣將紀靈等步騎三萬攻備，備求救於布。布諸將謂布曰：「將軍常欲殺備，今可假手於術。」布曰：「不然。術若破備，則北連太山諸將，吾爲在術圍中，不得不救也。」便嚴步兵千、騎二百，馳往赴備。靈等聞布至，皆斂兵不敢復攻。布於沛西南一里安屯，遣鈴下請靈等，靈等亦請布共飲食。布謂靈等曰：「玄德，布弟也。弟爲諸君所困，故來救之。布性不喜合鬬，但喜解鬬耳。」布令門候於營門中舉一隻戟，布言：「諸君觀布射戟小支，一發中者諸君當解去，不中可留決鬬。」布舉弓射戟，正中小支。諸將皆驚，言「將軍天威也」！明日復歡會，然後各罷。

context.beforeSource: 而此云諫稱尊號，未詳孰是。
context.afterSource: 術欲結布爲援，乃爲子索布女，布許之。
context.beforeLocal: 而此云諫稱尊號，未詳孰是。
context.afterLocal: 術欲結布爲援，乃爲子索布女，布許之。

manualTranslations.zh: 備東擊術，布襲取下邳，備還歸布。
manualTranslations.literal: Bei campaigned east against Shu; Bu raided and seized Xiapi; Bei returned and submitted to Bu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Bei marched east against Yuan Shu; Lü Bu seized Xiapi by surprise; Liu Bei returned and submitted to Lü Bu.

manualTranslations.zh: 布遣備屯小沛。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu sent Bei to garrison Xiaopei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu sent Liu Bei to garrison Xiaopei.

manualTranslations.zh: 布自稱徐州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu styled himself Inspector of Xu Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu styled himself Inspector of Xu Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 〈《英雄記》曰：布初入徐州，書與袁術。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈The Yingxiong ji says: When Bu first entered Xu Province, he wrote to Yuan Shu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈The Record of Heroes says: when Lü Bu first entered Xu Province, he wrote to Yuan Shu.

manualTranslations.zh: 術報書曰：「昔董卓作亂，破壞王室，禍害術門戶，術舉兵關東，未能屠裂卓。
manualTranslations.literal: Shu replied in writing: "Formerly Dong Zhuo raised rebellion, destroyed the royal house, and harmed Shu's household; Shu raised troops east of the Pass but could not slaughter Zhuo.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuan Shu replied: "When Dong Zhuo raised rebellion, he destroyed the royal house and harmed my house. I raised troops east of the mountains but could not destroy him.

manualTranslations.zh: 將軍誅卓，送其頭首，爲術掃滅讐耻，使術明目於當世，死生不愧，其功一也。
manualTranslations.literal: The General executed Zhuo and sent his head, sweeping away Shu's feud shame for him, letting Shu hold his head high in the age without shame in life or death—this is your first merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You executed Dong Zhuo and sent me his head, wiping away my blood feud and letting me hold my head high in the age—your first merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 昔將金元休向兖州，甫詣封，爲曹操逆所拒破，流離迸走，幾至滅亡。
manualTranslations.literal: Formerly General Jin Yuansxiu went toward Yan Province; just as he reached Feng he was repulsed and broken by the rebel Cao Cao, fled in disorder, and nearly perished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Formerly General Jin Yuansxiu went toward Yan Province; just as he reached his commandery he was beaten back by Cao Cao, fled in disorder, and nearly perished.

manualTranslations.zh: 將軍破兖州，術復明目於遐邇，其功二也。
manualTranslations.literal: The General broke Yan Province and Shu again held his head high far and near—this is your second merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You broke Yan Province and restored my standing far and near—your second merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 術生年已來，不聞天下有劉備，備乃舉兵與術對戰；
manualTranslations.literal: In all the years of Shu's life he had not heard that the realm held Liu Bei; Bei then raised troops to fight Shu;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In all my years I had never heard of Liu Bei in the realm, yet he raised troops to fight me;

manualTranslations.zh: 術憑將軍威靈，得以破備，其功三也。
manualTranslations.literal: Shu relied on the General's numinous might and was able to defeat Bei—this is your third merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I relied on your prestige to defeat him—your third merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 將軍有三大功在術，術雖不敏，奉以生死。
manualTranslations.literal: The General has three great merits toward Shu; though Shu is not clever, he offers life and death in return.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You have done three great deeds for me; though I am no sage, I offer you my life.

manualTranslations.zh: 將軍連年攻戰，軍糧苦少，今送米二十萬斛，迎逢道路，非直此止，當駱驛復致；
manualTranslations.literal: The General has campaigned year after year and military grain is painfully scarce; now I send two hundred thousand hu of rice, meeting you on the road—not only this, but more will follow in relays;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You have fought year after year and grain runs short; I now send two hundred thousand hu of rice to meet you on the road—not this alone, but more will follow in relays;

manualTranslations.zh: 若兵器戰具，佗所乏少，大小唯命。」
manualTranslations.literal: if weapons and war gear or anything else you lack, great or small, command as you will."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and for weapons, gear, or anything else you lack, great or small, command as you will."

manualTranslations.zh: 布得書大喜，遂造下邳。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu received the letter and was greatly pleased; he thereupon went to Xiapi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu was delighted by the letter and went on to Xiapi.

manualTranslations.zh: 《典略》曰：元休名尚，京兆人也。
manualTranslations.literal: The Dianlüe says: Yuansxiu's given name was Shang; he was a man of Jingzhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Brief Account says: Yuansxiu's given name was Shang, a native of Jingzhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 尚與同郡韋休甫、第五文休俱著名，號爲三休。
manualTranslations.literal: Shang, together with Wei Xiufu of the same commandery and Diwu Wenxiu, were all famous and were styled the Three Xiu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shang, Wei Xiufu of the same commandery, and Diwu Wenxiu were all famous and were styled the Three Xiu.

manualTranslations.zh: 尚，獻帝初爲兖州刺史，東之郡，而太祖已臨兖州。
manualTranslations.literal: Shang, at the beginning of Emperor Xian's reign, was Inspector of Yan Province; going east to his commandery, Grand Progenitor had already reached Yan Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Xian's reign Shang was Inspector of Yan Province; marching east to take up office, he found Cao Cao already in Yan Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 尚南依袁術。
manualTranslations.literal: Shang went south and relied on Yuan Shu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shang went south and relied on Yuan Shu.

manualTranslations.zh: 術僭號，欲以尚爲太尉，不敢顯言，私使人諷之，尚無屈意，術亦不敢彊也。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shu usurped the title, he wished to make Shang Grand Commandant; not daring to speak openly, he privately sent men to hint at it; Shang had no yielding intent, and Shu also did not dare force him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yuan Shu usurped imperial title he wished to make Shang Grand Commandant; not daring to speak openly, he sent private hints, but Shang would not yield and Yuan Shu did not dare force him.

manualTranslations.zh: 建安初，尚逃還，爲術所害。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Jian'an, Shang fled back and was killed by Shu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jian'an, Shang fled back and was killed by Yuan Shu.

manualTranslations.zh: 其後尚喪與太傅馬日磾喪俱至京師，天子嘉尚忠烈，爲之咨嗟，詔百官弔祭，拜子瑋郎中，而日磾不與焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Afterward Shang's funeral bier and Grand Tutor Ma Midi's funeral bier both reached the capital; the Son of Heaven praised Shang's loyal martyrdom, sighed over him, ordered the hundred officials to mourn and sacrifice, and appointed his son Wei as Gentleman of the Palace, while Midi was not included.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later Shang's funeral train and Grand Tutor Ma Midi's both reached the capital. The emperor praised Shang's loyal martyrdom, ordered court mourning, and appointed his son Wei as a palace gentleman—Midi received no such honor.

manualTranslations.zh: 《英雄記》曰：布水陸東下，軍到下邳西四十里。
manualTranslations.literal: The Yingxiong ji says: Bu advanced east by water and land; his army reached forty li west of Xiapi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Record of Heroes says: Lü Bu advanced east by water and land until his army stood forty li west of Xiapi.

manualTranslations.zh: 備中郎將丹楊許耽夜遣司馬章誑來詣布，言「張益德與下邳相曹豹共爭，益德殺豹，城中大亂，不相信。
manualTranslations.literal: Bei's Central Gentleman-General Xu Dan of Danyang by night sent Major Zhang Kuang to come to Bu, saying: "Zhang Yide and the Chancellor of Xiapi Cao Bao quarreled; Yide killed Bao; the city is in great disorder and trust is gone.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Bei's Central Gentleman-General Xu Dan of Danyang sent Major Zhang Kuang by night to Lü Bu, saying: "Zhang Yide quarreled with Xiapi's chancellor Cao Bao; Yide killed Bao; the city is in chaos and trust is gone.

manualTranslations.zh: 丹楊兵有千人屯西白城門內，聞將軍來東，大小踊躍，如復更生。
manualTranslations.literal: A thousand Danyang troops are garrisoned inside the West White Gate; hearing the General is coming east, great and small leap for joy as if reborn.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A thousand Danyang troops hold the West White Gate within; hearing you are coming east, everyone leaps for joy as if reborn.

manualTranslations.zh: 將軍兵向城西門，丹楊軍便開門內將軍矣」。
manualTranslations.literal: If the General's troops head for the west gate, the Danyang troops will open the gate and admit the General."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: March on the west gate and the Danyang troops will open it and admit you."

manualTranslations.zh: 布遂夜進，晨到城下。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu thereupon advanced by night and at dawn reached below the walls.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu advanced by night and at dawn reached the walls.

manualTranslations.zh: 天明，丹楊兵悉開門內布兵。
manualTranslations.literal: At daylight the Danyang troops all opened the gates and admitted Bu's troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At daylight the Danyang troops opened the gates and admitted Lü Bu's men.

manualTranslations.zh: 布於門上坐，步騎放火，大破益德兵，獲備妻子軍資及部曲將吏士家口。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu sat atop the gate; infantry and cavalry set fires and greatly defeated Yide's troops, capturing Bei's wife and children, military stores, and the households of his officers, clerks, and soldiers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu sat atop the gate; his foot and horse troops set fires, routed Zhang Yide's men, and seized Liu Bei's wife, children, stores, and the families of his officers and soldiers.

manualTranslations.zh: 建安元年六月夜半時，布將河內郝萌反，將兵入布所治下邳府，詣廳事閤外，同聲大呼攻閤，閤堅不得入。
manualTranslations.literal: At midnight in the sixth month of the first year of Jian'an, Bu's general Hao Meng of Henei rebelled, led troops into the Xiapi headquarters where Bu governed, came to the outer doors of the council hall, and all together shouted to attack the doors; the doors held firm and they could not enter.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At midnight in the sixth month of Jian'an 1, Lü Bu's general Hao Meng of Henei rebelled, led troops into Lü Bu's Xiapi headquarters, and shouted together to storm the council doors, but the doors held.

manualTranslations.zh: 布不知反者爲誰，直牽婦，科頭袒衣，相將從溷上排壁出，詣都督高順營，直排順門入。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu did not know who the rebel was; he simply took his wife by the hand, bareheaded and with bared torso, went together with her out through the privy by breaking the wall, and went to Colonel-Director Gao Shun's camp, pushing straight through Shun's gate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Not knowing who had rebelled, Lü Bu seized his wife's hand, bareheaded and shirtless, broke out through the privy wall, and fled straight into Gao Shun's camp.

manualTranslations.zh: 順問：「將軍有所隱不？」
manualTranslations.literal: Shun asked: "General, are you hiding something?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gao Shun asked, "General, are you hiding something?"

manualTranslations.zh: 布言「河內兒聲」。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu said, "The voice of the fellow from Henei."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu said, "The voice of the fellow from Henei."

manualTranslations.zh: 順言「此郝萌也」。
manualTranslations.literal: Shun said, "This is Hao Meng."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gao Shun said, "That is Hao Meng."

manualTranslations.zh: 順即嚴兵入府，弓弩並射萌衆；
manualTranslations.literal: Shun immediately arrayed troops and entered the headquarters; bows and crossbows shot together at Meng's host;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gao Shun immediately arrayed troops and entered the headquarters; bows and crossbows shot together at Hao Meng's men;

manualTranslations.zh: 萌衆亂走，天明還故營。
manualTranslations.literal: Meng's host fled in disorder; at daylight they returned to their former camp.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hao Meng's men fled in disorder; at daylight they returned to their former camp.

manualTranslations.zh: 萌將曹性反萌，與對戰，萌刺傷性，性斫萌一臂。
manualTranslations.literal: Meng's officer Cao Xing turned against Meng and fought him; Meng stabbed and wounded Xing; Xing hacked off one of Meng's arms.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hao Meng's officer Cao Xing turned against him; Hao Meng stabbed Cao Xing, and Cao Xing hacked off one of Hao Meng's arms.

manualTranslations.zh: 順斫萌首，牀輿性，送詣布。
manualTranslations.literal: Shun cut off Meng's head, carried Xing on a litter, and sent them to Bu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gao Shun cut off Hao Meng's head, carried Cao Xing on a litter, and brought them to Lü Bu.

manualTranslations.zh: 布問性，言「萌受袁術謀，謀者悉誰？」
manualTranslations.literal: Bu questioned Xing, saying, "Meng received Yuan Shu's plot—who were all the plotters?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu questioned Cao Xing: "Hao Meng followed Yuan Shu's plot—who were the plotters?"

manualTranslations.zh: 性言「陳宮同謀。」
manualTranslations.literal: Xing said, "Chen Gong plotted with him."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Xing said, "Chen Gong plotted with him."

manualTranslations.zh: 時宮在坐上，靣赤，傍人悉覺之。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Gong was seated in the hall; his face flushed and those beside him all noticed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chen Gong was seated in the hall; his face flushed and everyone nearby noticed.

manualTranslations.zh: 布以宮大將，不問也。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu, because Gong was a great general, did not question him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Chen Gong was a senior commander, Lü Bu did not question him.

manualTranslations.zh: 性言「萌常以此問，性言呂將軍大將有神，不可擊也，不意萌狂惑不止。」
manualTranslations.literal: Xing said, "Meng often asked this; Xing said General Lü the great commander has a spirit and cannot be attacked—I did not expect Meng's madness would not stop."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Xing added, "Hao Meng often asked me this; I told him General Lü had a guardian spirit and could not be attacked—I never expected his madness would not stop."

manualTranslations.zh: 布謂性曰：「卿健兒也！」
manualTranslations.literal: Bu said to Xing, "You are a stout fellow!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu told Cao Xing, "You are a stout fellow!"

manualTranslations.zh: 善養視之。
manualTranslations.literal: He treated him well and cared for him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He treated him well and cared for him.

manualTranslations.zh: 創愈，使安撫萌故營，領其衆。
manualTranslations.literal: When the wound healed, he had him pacify Meng's former camp and lead his host.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the wound healed, he had Cao Xing pacify Hao Meng's former camp and lead his troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 術遣將紀靈等步騎三萬攻備，備求救於布。
manualTranslations.literal: Shu sent the general Ji Ling and others with thirty thousand foot and horse to attack Bei; Bei begged rescue from Bu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuan Shu sent Ji Ling and others with thirty thousand foot and horse against Liu Bei; Liu Bei begged Lü Bu for rescue.

manualTranslations.zh: 布諸將謂布曰：「將軍常欲殺備，今可假手於術。」
manualTranslations.literal: Bu's generals said to Bu, "The General has always wished to kill Bei; now you can borrow Shu's hand."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu's officers told him, "You have always wanted Liu Bei dead—now let Yuan Shu do it for you."

manualTranslations.zh: 布曰：「不然。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu said, "Not so.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu said, "Not so.

manualTranslations.zh: 術若破備，則北連太山諸將，吾爲在術圍中，不得不救也。」
manualTranslations.literal: If Shu defeats Bei, he will link north with the generals of Mount Tai; I will be within Shu's encirclement and cannot but rescue him."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If Yuan Shu defeats Liu Bei, he will link north with the Mount Tai generals and I will be trapped in Yuan Shu's net—I must rescue him."

manualTranslations.zh: 便嚴步兵千、騎二百，馳往赴備。
manualTranslations.literal: He thereupon arrayed a thousand infantry and two hundred cavalry and galloped to aid Bei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He arrayed a thousand infantry and two hundred cavalry and galloped to Liu Bei's aid.

manualTranslations.zh: 靈等聞布至，皆斂兵不敢復攻。
manualTranslations.literal: Ling and the others, hearing Bu had arrived, all restrained their troops and did not dare attack again.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ji Ling and the others, hearing Lü Bu had arrived, restrained their troops and dared not attack again.

manualTranslations.zh: 布於沛西南一里安屯，遣鈴下請靈等，靈等亦請布共飲食。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu encamped one li southwest of Pei, sent a bell-man to invite Ling and the others, and Ling and the others also invited Bu to drink and eat together.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu encamped one li southwest of Pei, sent an attendant to invite Ji Ling and the others, and they in turn invited him to feast.

manualTranslations.zh: 布謂靈等曰：「玄德，布弟也。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu said to Ling and the others, "Xuande is Bu's younger brother.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu told Ji Ling and the others, "Xuande is my younger brother.

manualTranslations.zh: 弟爲諸君所困，故來救之。
manualTranslations.literal: The younger brother is distressed by you gentlemen, therefore I have come to rescue him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: My younger brother is in trouble with you, so I have come to rescue him.

manualTranslations.zh: 布性不喜合鬬，但喜解鬬耳。」
manualTranslations.literal: Bu by nature does not like joining battle, but only likes resolving battle."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By nature I do not like joining battle—I only like ending it."

manualTranslations.zh: 布令門候於營門中舉一隻戟，布言：「諸君觀布射戟小支，一發中者諸君當解去，不中可留決鬬。」
manualTranslations.literal: Bu ordered the gate warden to raise a single halberd in the camp gate; Bu said, "You gentlemen watch Bu shoot the halberd's small branch—if with one shot he hits it, you gentlemen ought to disperse; if he misses, you may remain and decide the battle."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu had a gate warden raise a halberd in the camp gate and said, "Watch me shoot the halberd's side branch—if I hit it with one shot, disperse; if I miss, stay and fight."

manualTranslations.zh: 布舉弓射戟，正中小支。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu raised his bow and shot the halberd, hitting the small branch squarely.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Bu drew his bow and hit the side branch squarely.

manualTranslations.zh: 諸將皆驚，言「將軍天威也」！
manualTranslations.literal: The generals were all astonished and said, "The General's heaven-sent might!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The officers were astonished and cried, "Heaven-sent might!"

manualTranslations.zh: 明日復歡會，然後各罷。
manualTranslations.literal: The next day they feasted again in joy, and afterward each dispersed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next day they feasted again, and afterward each went his way.

sourceRange.text: 天子之在河東，楊將兵至安邑，拜安國將軍，封晉陽侯。楊欲迎天子還洛，諸將不聽；楊還野王。建安元年，楊奉、董承、韓暹挾天子還舊京，糧乏。楊以糧迎道路，遂至洛陽。謂諸將曰：「天子當與天下共之，幸有公卿大臣，楊當捍外難，何事京都？」遂還野王。即拜為大司馬。《英雄記》曰：楊性仁和，無威刑。下人謀反，發覺，對之涕泣，輒原不問。楊素與呂布善。太祖之圍布，楊欲救之，不能。乃出兵東市，遙為之勢。其將楊醜，殺楊以應太祖。楊將眭固殺醜，將其眾，欲北合袁紹。太祖遣史渙邀擊，破之於犬城，斬固，盡收其眾也。《典略》曰：固字白兔，既殺楊醜，軍屯射犬。時有巫誡固曰：「將軍字兔而此邑名犬，兔見犬，其勢必驚，宜急移去。」固不從，遂戰死。

sourceRange.text: 張燕，常山真定人也，本姓褚。黃巾起，燕合聚少年為群盜，在山澤間轉攻，還真定，眾萬餘人。博陵張牛角亦起眾，自號將兵從事，與燕合。燕推牛角為帥，俱攻癭陶。牛角為飛矢所中。被創且死，令眾奉燕，告曰：「必以燕為帥。」牛角死，眾奉燕，故改姓張。燕剽捍捷速過人，故軍中號曰飛燕。其後人眾寢廣，常山、趙郡、中山、上黨、河內諸山谷皆相通，其小帥孫輕、王當等，各以部眾從燕，眾至百萬，號曰黑山。靈帝不能征，河北諸郡被其害。燕遣人至京都乞降，拜燕平難中郎將。《九州春秋》曰：張角之反也，黑山、白波、黃龍、左校、牛角、五鹿、羝根、苦蝤、劉石、平漢、大洪、司隸、緣城、羅市、雷公、浮雲、飛燕、白爵、楊鳳、於毒等各起兵，大者二三萬，小者不減數千。靈帝不能討，乃遣使拜楊鳳為黑山校尉，領諸山賊，得舉孝廉計吏。後遂瀰漫，不可復數。《典略》曰：黑山、黃巾諸帥，本非冠蓋，自相號字，謂騎白馬者為張白騎，謂輕捷者為張飛燕，謂聲大者為張雷公，其饒須者則自稱於羝根，其眼大者自稱李大目。張璠《漢紀》云：又有左校、郭大賢、左髭丈八三部也。是後，董卓遷天子於長安，天下兵數起，燕遂以其眾與豪傑相結。袁紹與公孫瓚爭冀州，燕遣將杜長等助瓚，與紹戰，為紹所敗，人眾稍散，太祖將定冀州，燕遣使求佐王師，拜平北將軍；率眾詣鄴，封安國亭侯，邑五百戶。燕薨，子方嗣。方薨，子融嗣。陸機《晉惠帝起居注》曰：門下通事令史張林，飛燕之曾孫。林與趙王倫為亂，未及周年，位至尚書令、衛將軍，封郡公。尋為倫所殺。

sourceRange.text: 魯薨，諡之曰原侯。子富嗣。《魏略》曰：劉雄鳴者，藍田人也。少以採藥射獵為事，常居覆車山下，每晨夜，出行雲霧中，以識道不迷，而時人因謂之能為雲霧。郭、李之亂，人多就之。建安中，附屬州郡，州郡表薦為小將。馬超等反，不肯從，超破之。後詣太祖，太祖執其手謂之曰：「孤方入關，夢得一神人，即卿邪！」乃厚禮之，表拜為將軍，遣令迎其部黨。部黨不欲降，遂劫以反，諸亡命皆往依之，有眾數千人，據武關道口。太祖遣夏侯淵討破之，雄鳴南奔漢中。漢中破，窮無所之，乃復歸降。太祖捉其鬚曰：「老賊，真得汝矣！」復其官，徙勃海。時又有程銀、侯選、李堪，皆河東人也，興平之亂，各有眾千餘家。建安十六年，並與馬超合。超破走，堪臨陳死。銀、選南入漢中，漢中破，詣太祖降，皆复官爵。

context.afterSource: 評曰：公孫瓚保京，坐待夷滅。

sourceRange.text: 明帝於是拜淵大司馬，封樂浪公，持節、領郡如故。《魏名臣奏》載中領軍夏侯獻表曰：「公孫淵昔年敢違王命，廢絕計貢者，實挾兩端。既恃阻險，又怙孫權。故敢跋扈，恣睢海外。宿舒親見賊權軍眾府庫，知其弱少不足憑恃，是以決計斬賊之使。又高句麗、濊貊與淵為仇，並為寇鈔。今外失吳援，內有胡寇，心知國家能從陸道，勢不得不懷惶懼之心。因斯之時，宜遣使示以禍福。奉車都尉鬷弘，武皇帝時始奉使命，開通道路。文皇帝即位，欲通使命，遣弘將妻子還歸鄉里，賜其車、牛，絹百匹。弘以受恩，歸死國朝，無有還意，乞留妻子，身奉使命。公孫康遂稱臣妾。以弘奉使稱意，賜爵關內侯。弘性果烈，乃心於國，夙夜拳拳，念自竭效。冠族子孫，少好學問，博通書記，多所關涉，口論速捷，辯而不俗，附依典誥，若出胸臆，加仕本郡，常在人右，彼方士人素所敬服。若當遣使，以為可使弘行。弘乃自舊土，習其國俗，為說利害，辯足以動其意，明足以見其事，才足以行之，辭足以見信。若其計從，雖酈生之降齊王，陸賈之說尉佗，亦無以遠過也。欲進遠路，不宜釋騏驥；將已篤疾，不宜廢扁鵲。原察愚言也。」使者至，淵設甲兵為軍陳，出見使者，又數對國中賓客出惡言。《吳書》曰：魏遣使者傅容、聶夔拜淵為樂浪公。淵計吏從洛陽還，語淵曰：「使者左駿伯，使皆擇勇力者，非凡人也。」淵由是疑怖。容、夔至，住學館中。淵先以步騎圍之，乃入受拜。容、夔大怖，由是還洛言狀。景初元年，乃遣幽州刺史毌丘儉等齎璽書徵淵。淵遂發兵，逆於遼隧，與儉等戰。儉等不利而還。淵遂自立為燕王，置百官有司。遣使者持節，假鮮卑單于璽，封拜邊民，誘呼鮮卑，侵擾北方。《魏書》曰：淵知此變非獨出儉，遂為備。遣使謝吳，自稱燕王，求為與國。然猶令官屬上書自直於魏曰：大司馬長史臣郭昕、參軍臣柳浦等七百八十九人言：奉被今年七月己卯詔書，伏讀懇切，精魄散越，不知身命所當投措！

sourceRange.text: 初平元年190年，度知中國擾攘，語所親吏柳毅、陽儀等曰：「漢祚將絕，當與諸卿圖王耳。」《魏書》曰：度語毅、儀：「讖書云孫登當為天子，太守姓公孫，字升濟，升即登也。」時襄平延里社生大石，長丈餘，下有三小石為之足。或謂度曰：「此漢宣帝冠石之祥，而裡名與先君同。社主土地，明當有土地，而三公為輔也。」度益喜。故河內太守李敏，郡中知名，惡度所為，恐為所害，乃將家屬入於海。度大怒，掘其父塚，剖棺焚屍，誅其宗族。《晉陽秋》曰：敏子追求敏，出塞，越二十餘年不娶。州里徐邈責之曰：「不孝莫大於無後，何可終身不娶乎！」乃娶妻，生子胤而遣妻，常如居喪之禮，不勝憂，數年而卒。胤生不識父母，及有識，蔬食哀戚亦如三年之喪。以祖父不知存亡，設主奉之。由是知名，仕至司徒。臣松之案：本傳云敏將家入海，而復與子相失，未詳其故。分遼東郡為遼西中遼郡，置太守。越海收東萊諸縣，置營州刺史。自立為遼東侯、平州牧，追封父延為建義侯。立漢二祖廟，承制設壇墠於襄平城南，郊祀天地，藉田，治兵，乘鸞路，九旒，旄頭羽騎。太祖表度為武威將軍，封永寧鄉侯，度曰：「我王遼東，何永寧也！」藏印綬武庫。度死，子康嗣位，以永寧鄉侯封弟恭。是歲建安九年也。

sourceRange.text: 二年春，遣太尉司馬宣王徵淵。六月，軍至遼東。《漢晉春秋》曰：公孫淵自立，稱紹漢元年。聞魏人將討，復稱臣於吳，乞兵北伐以自救。吳人欲戮其使，羊衜曰：「不可，是肆匹夫之怒而捐霸王之計也。不如因而厚之，遣奇兵潛往以要其成。若魏伐淵不克，而我軍遠赴，是恩結遐夷，義蓋萬里，若兵連不解，首尾離隔，則我虜其傍郡，驅略而歸，亦足以致天之罰，報雪曩事矣。」權曰：「善」。乃勒兵大出。謂淵使曰：「請俟後問，當從簡書，必與弟同休戚，共存亡，雖隕於中原，吾所甘心也。」又曰：「司馬懿所向無前，深為弟憂也。」淵遣將軍卑衍、楊祚等步騎數万屯遼隧，圍塹二十餘里。宣王軍至，令衍逆戰。宣王遣將軍胡遵等擊破之。宣王令軍穿圍，引兵東南向，而急東北，即趨襄平。衍等恐襄平無守，夜走。諸軍進至首山，淵復遣衍等迎軍殊死戰。复擊，大破之，遂進軍造城下，為圍塹。會霖雨三十餘日，遼水暴長，運船自遼口徑至城下。雨霽，起土山、脩櫓，為發石連弩射城中。淵窘急。糧盡，人相食，死者甚多。將軍楊祚等降。八月丙寅夜，大流星長數十丈，從首山東北墜襄平城東南。壬午，淵眾潰，與其子脩將數百騎突圍東南走，大兵急擊之，當流星所墜處，斬淵父子。城破，斬相國以下首級以千數，傳淵首洛陽，遼東、帶方、樂浪、玄菟悉平。

sourceRange.text: 尚有愛妾嬖幸，寵奪適室；適室，曹氏女也，故文帝遣人絞殺之。尚悲感，發病怳惚，旣葬埋妾，不勝思見，復出視之。文帝聞而恚之曰：「杜襲之輕薄尚，良有以也。」然以舊臣，恩寵不衰。六年，尚疾篤，還京都，帝數臨幸，執手涕泣。尚薨，謚曰悼侯。《魏書》載詔曰：「尚自少侍從，盡誠竭節，雖云異姓，其猶骨肉，是以入爲腹心，出當爪牙。智略深敏，謀謨過人，不幸早殞，命也柰何！贈征南大將軍、昌陵侯印綬。」子玄嗣。又分尚戶三百，賜尚弟子奉爵關內侯。

sourceRange.text: 太祖自徐州還，惇從征吕布，爲流矢所中，傷左目。《魏略》曰：時夏侯淵與惇俱爲將軍，軍中號惇爲盲夏侯。惇惡之，每照鏡恚怒，輒撲鏡於地。復領陳留、濟陰太守，加建武將軍，封高安鄉侯。時大旱，蝗蟲起，惇乃斷太壽水作陂，身自負土，率將士勸種稻，民賴其利。轉領河南尹。太祖平河北，爲大將軍後拒。鄴破，遷伏波將軍，領尹如故，使得以便宜從事，不拘科制。建安十二年，錄惇前後功，增封邑千八百户，并前二千五百户。二十一年，從征孫權還，使惇都督二十六軍，留居巢。賜伎樂名倡，令曰：「魏絳以和戎之功，猶受金石之樂，況將軍乎！」二十四年，太祖軍於摩陂，召惇常與同載，特見親重，出入臥内，諸將莫得比也。拜前將軍，《魏書》曰：時諸將皆受魏官號，惇獨漢官，乃上疏自陳不當不臣之禮。太祖曰：「吾聞太上師臣，其次友臣。夫臣者，貴德之人也，區區之魏，而臣足以屈君乎？」惇固請，乃拜爲前將軍。督諸軍還壽春，徙屯召陵。文帝即王位，拜惇大將軍，數月薨。惇雖在軍旅，親迎師受業。性清儉，有餘財輒以分施，不足資之於官，不治產業。諡曰忠侯。子充嗣。帝追思惇功，欲使子孫畢侯，分惇邑千户，賜惇七子二孫爵皆關内侯。惇弟廉及子楙素自封列侯。初，太祖以女妻楙，即清河公主也。楙歷位侍中尚書、安西鎮東將軍，假節。《魏略》曰：楙字子林，惇中子也。文帝少與楙親，及即位，以爲安西將軍、持節，承夏侯淵處都督關中。楙性無武略，而好治生。至太和二年228年，明帝西征，人有白楙者，遂召還爲尚書。楙在西時，多畜伎妾，公主由此與楙不和。其後羣弟不遵禮度，楙數切責，弟懼見治，乃共構楙以誹謗，公主奏之，有詔收楙。帝意欲殺之，以問長水校尉京兆段默，默以爲「此必清河公主與楙不睦，出於譖構，冀不推實耳。且伏波與先帝有定天下之功，宜加三思」。帝意解，曰：「吾亦以爲然。」乃發詔推問爲公主作表者，果其羣弟子臧、子江所構也。充薨，子廙嗣。廙薨，子劭嗣。《晉陽秋》曰：泰始二年266年，高安鄉侯夏侯佐卒，惇之孫也，嗣絕。詔曰：「惇，魏之元功，勳書竹帛。昔庭堅不祀，猶或悼之，況朕受禪於魏，而可以忘其功臣哉！宜擇惇近屬劭封之。」韓浩者，河内人。及沛國史渙與浩俱以忠勇顯。浩至中護軍，渙至中領軍，皆掌禁兵，封列侯。《魏書》曰：韓浩字元嗣。漢末兵起，縣近山藪，多寇，浩聚徒眾爲縣籓衛。太守王匡以爲從事，將兵拒董卓於盟津。時浩舅杜陽爲河陰令，卓執之，使招浩，浩不從。袁术聞而壯之，以爲騎都尉。夏侯惇聞其名，請與相見，大奇之，使領兵從征伐。時大議損益，浩以爲當急田。太祖善之，遷護軍。太祖欲討柳城，領軍史渙以爲道遠深入，非完計也，欲與浩共諫。浩曰：「今兵勢彊盛，威加四海，戰勝攻取，無不如志，不以此時遂除天下之患，將爲後憂。且公神武，舉無遺策，吾與君爲中軍主，不宜沮眾。」遂從破柳城，改其官爲中護軍，置長史、司馬。從討張魯，魯降。議者以浩智略足以綏邊，欲留使都督諸軍，鎮漢中。太祖曰：「吾安可以無護軍？」乃與俱還。其見親任如此。及薨，太祖愍惜之。無子，以養子榮嗣。史渙字公劉。少任俠，有雄氣。太祖初起，以客從，行中軍校尉，從征伐，常監諸將，見親信，轉拜中領軍。十四年薨。子静嗣。

sourceRange.text: 仁少時不脩行检，及長爲將，嚴整奉法令，常置科於左右，案以從事。鄢陵侯彰北征烏丸，文帝在東宫，爲書戒彰曰：「爲將奉法，不當如征南邪！」及即王位，拜仁车騎將軍，都督荆、揚、益州諸軍事，進封陳侯，增邑二千，并前三千五百户。追賜仁父炽諡曰陳穆侯，置守冢十家。後召還屯宛。孫權遣將陳邵据襄陽，詔仁討之。仁與徐晃攻破邵，遂入襄陽，使將軍高遷等徙漢南附化民於漢北，文帝遣使即拜仁大將軍。又詔仁移屯临潁，遷大司馬，復督諸軍据烏江，還屯合肥。黃初四年薨，諡曰忠侯。《魏書》曰：仁時年五十六。《傅子》曰：曹大司馬之勇，賁、育弗加也。張辽其次焉。子泰嗣，官至鎮東將軍，假節，轉封甯陵侯。泰薨，子初嗣。又分封泰弟楷、範，皆爲列侯，而牛金官至後將軍。仁弟純，《英雄記》曰：純字子和。

曹洪字子廉，太祖從弟也。《魏書》曰：洪伯父鼎爲尚書令，任洪爲蕲春長。太祖起義兵討董卓，至荥陽，爲卓將徐榮所敗。太祖失馬，賊追甚急，洪下，以馬授太祖，太祖辞讓，洪曰：「天下可無洪，不可無君。」遂步從到汴水，水深不得渡，洪循水得船，與太祖俱濟，還奔譙。揚州刺史陳温素與洪善，洪將家兵千餘人，就温募兵，得廬江上甲二千人，東到丹楊復得數千人，與太祖會龍亢。太祖征徐州，張邈舉兖州叛迎吕布。時大饑荒，洪將兵在前，先据東平、範，聚糧穀以繼軍。太祖討邈、布於濮陽，布破走，遂据東阿，轉擊濟陰、山陽、中牟、陽武、京、密十餘縣，皆拔之。以前後功拜鹰揚校尉，遷揚武中郎將。天子都许，拜洪諫議大夫。别征劉表，破表别將於舞陽、陰葉、堵陽、博望，有功，遷厉鋒將軍，封國明亭侯。累從征伐，拜都護將軍。文帝即位，爲衛將軍，遷骠騎將軍，進封野王侯，益邑千户，并前二千一百户，位特進；後徙封都陽侯。始，洪家富而性吝啬，文帝少時假求不稱，常恨之，遂以舍客犯法，下狱當死。羣臣并救莫能得。卞太后謂郭后曰：「令曹洪今日死，吾明日敕帝废后矣。」於是泣涕屡請，乃得免官削爵土。《魏略》曰：文帝收洪，時曹真在左右，請之曰：「今誅洪，洪必以真爲譖也。」帝曰：「我自治之，卿何豫也？」會卞太后責怒帝，言「梁、沛之間，非子廉無有今日」。詔乃釋之。猶尚沒入其財產。太后又以爲言，後乃還之。初，太祖爲司空時，以己率下，每歲发调，使本縣平赀。於時譙令平洪赀財與公家等，太祖曰：「我家赀那得如子廉耶！」文帝在東宫，尝從洪贷绢百匹，洪不稱意。及洪犯法，自分必死，既得原，喜，上書谢曰：「臣少不由道，过在人伦，長窃非任，遂蒙含贷。性無检度知足之分，而有豺狼無厌之質，老惛倍贪，触突國网，罪迫三千，不在赦宥，當就辜誅，棄諸市朝，猶蒙天恩，骨肉更生。臣仰视天日，愧負靈神，俯惟愆阙，惭愧怖悸，不能雉經以自裁割，谨涂颜阙門，拜章陳情。」洪先帝功臣，時人多爲觖望。明帝即位，拜後將軍，更封樂城侯，邑千户，位特進，復拜骠騎將軍。太和六年232年薨，諡曰恭侯。子馥，嗣侯。初，太祖分洪户封子震列侯。洪族父瑜，脩慎笃敬，官至衛將軍，封列侯。曹休字文烈，太祖族子也。天下亂，宗族各散去鄉里。休年十餘歲，喪父，獨與一客担喪假葬，携將老母，渡江至吴。《魏書》曰：休祖父尝爲吴郡太守。休於太守舍，見壁上祖父画像，下榻拜涕泣，同坐者皆嘉叹焉。以太祖舉義兵，易姓名轉至荆州，間行北歸，見太祖。太祖謂左右曰：「此吾家千里驹也。」使與文帝同止，見待如子。常從征伐，使領虎豹騎宿衛。劉備遣將吴兰屯下辯，太祖遣曹洪征之，以休爲騎都尉，参洪軍事。太祖謂休曰：「汝雖参軍，其實帥也。」洪聞此令，亦委事於休。備遣張飛屯固山，欲斷軍後。眾議狐疑，休曰：「賊實斷道者，當伏兵潜行。今乃先張声勢，此其不能也。宜及其未集，促擊兰，兰破則飛自走矣。」洪從之，進兵擊兰，大破之，飛果走。太祖拔漢中，諸軍還長安，拜休中領軍。文帝即王位，爲領軍將軍，錄前後功，封東陽亭侯。夏侯惇薨，以休爲鎮南將軍，假節都督諸軍事，车驾临送，上乃下舆執手而别。孫權遣將屯歷陽，休到，擊破之，又别遣兵渡江，燒賊芜湖營數千家。遷征東將軍，領揚州刺史，進封安陽鄉侯。《魏書》曰：休喪母至孝。帝使侍中夺喪服，使饮酒食肉，休受詔而形体益憔悴。乞歸譙葬母，帝復遣越騎校尉薛乔奉詔節其憂哀，使歸家治喪，一宿便葬，葬讫詣行在所。帝見，親自宽慰之。其見愛重如此。帝征孫權，以休爲征東大將軍，假黄钺，督張辽等及諸州郡二十餘軍，擊權大將吕範等於洞浦，破之。拜揚州牧。明帝即位，進封長平侯。吴將审德屯皖，休擊破之，斬德首，吴將韓綜、翟丹等前後率眾詣休降。增邑四百，并前二千五百户，遷大司馬，都督揚州如故。太和二年228年，帝爲二道征吴，遣司馬宣王從漢水下，〔休督〕諸軍向尋陽。賊將僞降，休深入，戰不利，退還宿石亭。軍夜惊，士卒亂，棄甲兵輜重甚多。休上書谢罪，帝遣屯騎校尉楊暨慰谕，禮賜益隆。休因此痈发背薨，諡曰壯侯。子肇嗣。《世語》曰：肇字長思。肇有當世才度，爲散騎常侍、屯騎校尉。明帝寝疾，方與燕王宇等屬以後事。帝意尋变，詔肇以侯歸第。正始中薨。追赠衛將軍。子興嗣。初，文帝分休户三百封肇弟纂爲列侯，後爲殄吴將軍，薨，追赠前將軍。張隐《文士傳》曰：肇孫摅，字颜遠，少厉志操，博學有才藻。仕晉，辟公府，歷洛陽令，有能名。大司馬齊王冏辅政，摅與齊人左思俱爲记室督。從中郎出爲襄陽太守、征南司馬。值天下亂，摅討賊向吴，戰敗死。曹真字子丹，太祖族子也。太祖起兵，真父邵募徒眾，爲州郡所殺。《魏略》曰：真本姓秦，養曹氏。或云其父伯南夙與太祖善。興平末，袁术部党與太祖攻劫，太祖出，爲寇所追，走入秦氏，伯南开門受之。寇問太祖所在，答云：「我是也。」遂害之。由此太祖思其功，故变其姓。《魏書》曰：邵以忠笃有才智，爲太祖所親信。初平中，太祖興義兵，邵募徒眾，從太祖周旋。時豫州刺史黄琬欲害太祖，太祖避之而邵獨遇害。太祖哀真少孤，收養與諸子同，使與文帝共止。常猎，爲虎所逐，顧射虎，應声而倒。太祖壯其鸷勇，使將虎豹騎。討靈丘賊，拔之，封靈壽亭侯。以偏將軍將兵擊劉備别將於下辯，破之，拜中堅將軍。從至長安，領中領軍。是時，夏侯淵沒於陽平，太祖憂之。以真爲征蜀護軍，督徐晃等破劉備别將高详於陽平。太祖自至漢中，拔出諸軍，使真至武都迎曹洪等還屯陳倉。文帝即王位，以真爲鎮西將軍，假節都督雍、涼州諸軍事。錄前後功，進封東鄉侯。張進等反於酒泉，真遣费曜討破之，斬進等。黃初三年還京都，以真爲上軍大將軍，都督中外諸軍事，假節钺。與夏侯尚等征孫權，擊牛渚屯，破之。轉拜中軍大將軍，加給事中。七年，文帝寝疾，真與陳羣、司馬宣王等受遺詔辅政。明帝即位，進封邵陵侯，臣松之案：真父名邵。封邵陵侯，若非書误，則事不可論。遷大將軍。

sourceRange.text: 清河王經亦與允俱稱冀州名士。甘露中爲尚書，坐高貴鄉公事誅。始經爲郡守，經母謂經曰：「汝田家子，今仕至二千石，物太過不祥，可以止矣。」經不能從，歷二州刺史，司隷校尉，終以致敗。《世語》曰：經字彥偉，初爲江夏太守。大將軍曹爽附絹二十匹令交市於吳，經不發書，棄官歸。母問歸狀，經以實對。母以經典兵馬而擅去，對送吏杖經五十，爽聞，不復罪。經爲司隷校尉，辟河內向雄爲都官從事，王業之出，不申經，竟以及難。經刑於東市，雄哭之，感動一市。刑及經母，雍州故吏皇甫晏以家財收葬焉。《漢晉春秋》曰：經被收，辭母。母顏色不變，笑而應曰：「人誰不死？往所以不止汝者，恐不得其所也。以此并命，何恨之有哉？」晉武帝太始元年詔曰：「故尚書王經，雖身陷法辟，然守志可嘉。門戶堙沒，意常愍之，其賜經孫郎中。」允友人同郡崔贊，亦嘗以處世太盛戒允云。荀綽《冀州記》曰：贊子洪，字良伯，清恪有匪躬之志，爲晉吏部尚書、大司農。

初，張當私以所擇才人張、何等與爽。疑其有姦，收當治罪。當陳爽與晏等陰謀反逆，並先習兵，須三月中欲發，於是收晏等下獄。會公卿朝臣廷議，以爲「春秋之義，『君親無將，將而必誅』。爽以支屬，世蒙殊寵，親受先帝握手遺詔，託以天下，而包藏禍心，蔑棄顧命，乃與晏、颺及當等謀圖神器，範黨同罪人，皆爲大逆不道」。於是收爽、羲、訓、晏、颺、謐、軌、勝、範、當等，皆伏誅，夷三族。《魏略》曰：鄧颺字玄茂，鄧禹後也。少得士名於京師。明帝時爲尚書郎，除洛陽令，坐事免，拜中郎，又入兼中書郎。初，颺與李勝等爲浮華友，及在中書，浮華事發，被斥出，遂不復用。正始初，乃出爲潁川太守，轉大將軍長史，遷侍中尚書。颺爲人好貨，前在內職，許臧艾授以顯官，艾以父妾與颺，故京師爲之語曰：「以官易婦鄧玄茂。」每所薦達，多如此比。故何晏選舉不得人，頗由颺之不公忠，遂同其罪，蓋由交友非其才。《魏略》曰：丁謐，字彥靖。父斐，字文侯。初，斐隨太祖，太祖以斐鄉里，特饒愛之。斐性好貨，數請求犯法，輒得原宥。爲典軍校尉，總攝內外，每所陳說，多見從之。建安末，從太祖征吳。斐隨行，自以家牛羸困，乃私易官牛，爲人所白，被收送獄，奪官。其後太祖問斐曰：「文侯，印綬所在？」斐亦知見戲，對曰：「以易餅耳。」太祖笑，顧謂左右曰：「東曹毛掾數白此家，欲令我重治，我非不知此人不清，良有以也。我之有斐，譬如人家有盜狗而善捕鼠，盜雖有小損，而完我囊貯。」遂復斐官，聽用如初。後數歲，病亡。謐少不肯交游，但博觀書傳。爲人沈毅，頗有才略。太和中，常住鄴，借人空屋，居其中。而諸王亦欲借之，不知謐已得，直開門入。謐望見王，交脚臥而不起，而呼其奴客曰：「此何等人？促呵使去。」王怒其無禮，還具上言。明帝收謐，繫鄴獄，以其功臣子，原出。後帝聞其有父風，召拜度支郎中。曹爽宿與相親，時爽爲武衞將軍，數爲帝稱其可大用。會帝崩，爽輔政，乃拔謐爲散騎常侍，遂轉尚書。謐爲人外似踈略，而內多忌。其在臺閣，數有所彈駮，臺中患之，事不得行。又其意輕貴，多所忽略，雖與何晏、鄧颺等同位，而皆少之，唯以勢屈於爽。爽亦敬之，言無不從。故於時謗書，謂「臺中有三狗，二狗崖柴不可當，一狗憑默作疽囊。」三狗，謂何、鄧、丁也。默者，爽小字也。其意言三狗皆欲嚙人，而謐尤甚也。奏使郭太後出居別宮，及遣樂安王使北詣鄴，又遣文欽令還淮南，皆謐之計。司馬宣王由是特深恨之。畢軌，字昭先。父字子禮，建安中爲典農校尉。軌以才能，少有名聲。明帝在東宮時，軌在文學中。黃初末，出爲長史。明帝即位，入爲黃門郎，子尚公主，居處殷富。遷并州刺史。其在并州，名爲驕豪。時雜虜數爲暴，害吏民，軌輒出軍擊鮮卑軻比能，失利。中護軍蔣濟表曰：「畢軌前失，旣往不咎，但恐是後難可以再。凡人材有長短，不可彊成。軌文雅志意，自爲美器。今失并州，換置他州，若入居顯職，不毀其德，於國事實善。此安危之要，唯聖恩察之。」至正始中，入爲中護軍，轉侍中尚書，遷司隷校尉。素與曹爽善，每言於爽，多見從之。李勝字公昭。父休字子朗，有智略。張魯前爲鎮北將軍，休爲司馬，家南鄭。時漢中有甘露降，子朗見張魯精兵數萬人，有四塞之固，遂建言赤氣久衰，黃家當興，欲魯舉號，魯不聽。會魯破，太祖以其勸魯內附，賜爵關內侯，署散官騎從，詣鄴。至黃初中，仕歷上黨、鉅鹿二郡太守，後以年老還，拜議郎。勝少游京師，雅有才智，與曹爽善。明帝禁浮華，而人白勝堂有四䆫八達，各有主名。用是被收，以其所連引者多，故得原，禁錮數歲。帝崩，曹爽輔政，勝爲洛陽令。夏侯玄爲征西將軍，以勝爲長史。玄亦宿與勝厚。駱穀之役，議從勝出，由是司馬宣王不恱於勝。累遷熒陽太守、河南尹。勝前後所宰守，未嘗不稱職，爲尹歲餘，廳事前屠蘇壞，令人更治之，小材一枚激墮，正檛受符吏石虎頭，斷之。後旬日，遷爲荊州刺史，未及之官而敗也。桓範字元則，世爲冠族。建安末，入丞相府。延康中，爲羽林左監。以有文學，與王象等典集皇覽。明帝時爲中領軍尚書，遷征虜將軍、東中郎將，使持節都督青、徐諸軍事，治下邳。與徐州刺史鄭岐爭屋，引節欲斬岐，爲岐所奏，不直，坐免還。復爲兖州刺吏，怏怏不得意。又聞當轉爲冀州牧。是時冀州統屬鎮北，而鎮北將軍呂昭才實仕進，本在範後。範謂其妻仲長曰：「我寧作諸卿，向三公長跪耳，不能爲呂子展屈也。」其妻曰：「君前在東，坐欲擅斬徐州刺史，衆人謂君難爲作下，今復羞爲呂屈，是復難爲作上也。」範忿其言觸實，乃以刀環撞其腹。妻時懷孕，遂墮胎死。範亦竟稱疾，不赴冀州。正始中拜大司農。範前在臺閣，號爲曉事，及爲司農，又以清省稱。範嘗抄撮《漢書》中諸雜事，自以意斟酌之，名曰世要論。蔣濟爲太尉，嘗與範會社下，羣卿列坐有數人，範懷其所撰，欲以示濟，謂濟當虛心觀之。範出其書以示左右，左右傳之示濟，濟不肯視，範心恨之。因論他事，乃發怒謂濟曰：「我祖薄德，公輩何似邪？」濟性雖彊毅，亦知範剛毅，睨而不應，各罷。範於沛郡，仕次在曹真後。於時曹爽輔政，以範鄉里老宿，於九卿中特敬之，然不甚親也。及宣王起兵，閉城門，以範爲曉事，乃指召之，欲使領中領軍。範欲應召，而其子諫之，以車駕在外，不如南出。範疑有頃，兒又促之。範欲去而司農丞吏皆止範。範不從，乃突出至平昌城門，城門已閉。門候司蕃，故範舉吏也，範呼之，舉手中版以示之，矯曰：「有詔召我，卿促開門！」蕃欲求見詔書，範呵之，言「卿非我故吏邪，何以敢爾？」乃開之。範出城，顧謂蕃曰：「太傅圖逆，卿從我去！」蕃徒行不能及，遂避側。範南見爽，勸爽兄弟以天子詣許昌，徵四方以自輔。爽疑，羲又無言。範自謂羲曰：「事昭然，卿用讀書何爲邪！於今日卿等門戶倒矣！」俱不言。範又謂羲曰：「卿別營近在闕南，洛陽典農治在城外，呼召如意。今詣許昌，不過中宿，許昌別庫，足相被假；所憂當在穀食，而大司農印章在我身。」羲兄弟默然不從，中夜至五鼓，爽乃投刀於地，謂諸從駕羣臣曰：「我度太傅意，亦不過欲令我兄弟向己也。我獨有以不合於遠近耳！」遂進謂帝曰：「陛下作詔免臣官，報皇太後令。」範知爽首免而己必坐唱義也。範乃曰：「老子今茲坐卿兄弟族矣！」爽等旣免，帝還宮，遂令範隨從。到洛水浮橋北，望見宣王，下車叩頭而無言。宣王呼範姓曰：「桓大夫何爲爾邪！」車駕入宮，有詔範還復位。範詣闕拜章謝，待報。會司蕃詣鴻臚自首，具說範前臨出所道。宣王乃忿然曰：「誣人以反，於法何應？」主者曰：「科律，反受其罪。」乃收範於闕下。時人持範甚急，範謂部官曰：「徐之，我亦義士耳。」遂送廷尉。《世語》曰：初，爽夢二虎銜雷公，雷公若二升椀，放著庭中。爽惡之，以問占者，靈臺丞馬訓曰：「憂兵。」訓退，告其妻曰：「爽將以兵亡，不出旬日。」《漢晉春秋》曰：安定皇甫謐以九年冬夢至洛陽，自廟出，見車騎甚衆，以物呈廟云：「誅大將軍曹爽。」寤而以告其邑人，邑人曰：「君欲作曹人之夢乎！朝無公孫彊如何？且爽兄弟典重兵，又權尚書事，誰敢謀之？」謐曰：「爽無叔振鐸之請，苟失天機則離矣，何恃於彊？昔漢之閻顯，倚母後之尊，權國威命，可謂至重矣，閹人十九人一旦尸之，況爽兄弟乎？」《世語》曰：初，爽出，司馬魯芝留在府，聞有事，將營騎斫津門出赴爽。爽誅，擢爲御史中丞。及爽解印綬，將出，主簿楊綜止之曰：「公挾主握權，捨此以至東巿乎？」爽不從。有司奏綜導爽反，宣王曰：「各爲其主也。」宥之，以爲尚書郎。芝字世英，扶風人也。以後仕進至特進光祿大夫。綜字初伯，後爲安東將軍司馬文王長史。臣松之案：夏侯湛爲芝銘及干寶晉紀並云爽旣誅，宣王即擢芝爲并州刺史，以綜爲安東參軍。與《世語》不同。嘉平中，紹功臣世，封真族孫熙爲新昌亭侯，邑三百戶，以奉真後。干寶《晉紀》曰：蔣濟以曹真之勳力，不宜絕祀，故以熙爲後。濟又病其言之失信於爽，發病卒。
